Job Description:

DXC Technology (NYSE: DXC) helps global companies run their mission critical systems and operations while modernizing IT, optimizing data architectures, and ensuring security and scalability across public, private and hybrid clouds. The world’s largest companies and public sector organizations trust DXC to deploy services across the Enterprise Technology Stack to drive new levels of performance, competitiveness, and customer experience. Learn more about how we deliver excellence for our customers and colleagues at DXC.com.

At DXC we use the power of technology to deliver mission critical IT Services that our customers need to modernize operations and drive innovation across their entire IT estate. We provide services across the Enterprise Technology Stack for business process outsourcing, insurance, analytics and engineering, applications, security, cloud, IT outsourcing, and modern workplace.

Our DXC Insurance Services help our customers optimize and transform operations, lower costs, increase agile new channels to growth. Our people, technology and best practices improve and automate highly complex business processes middle and back offices- while facilitating customer experience transformation.

Essential Job Functions

The Project Manager plans, coordinates, and oversees customer-facing software implementation, migration, and custom projects. This includes preparing customer kickoff materials, developing and maintaining milestone plans, coordinating resource requests, tracking project financials, managing invoices, facilitating regular project meetings, documenting meeting minutes, monitoring risks and issues, and ensuring clear communication across all stakeholders.

  • Manage multiple customer projects concurrently, ensuring scope, schedule, budget, quality, and customer expectations are effectively controlled.

  • Develop, maintain, and communicate project milestone plans, schedules, status updates, meeting minutes, action items, and project documentation.

  • Own and track forecasts, actuals, revenue, billing, project hours, invoices, and other financial measures to support accurate project reporting and contract compliance.

  • Identify, document, and manage project risks, issues, dependencies, and constraints; recommend and implement mitigation plans as appropriate.

  • Monitor and identify potential scope changes or scope creep; coordinate change control activities when additional work or revised requirements are identified.

  • Coordinate with internal teams, technical resources, customers, and stakeholders to manage business requirements, technical requirements, schedules, and deliverables.

  • Facilitate customer and internal project meetings, ensuring decisions, action items, risks, and follow-ups are clearly documented and communicated.

  • Oversee assigned project team activities by providing direction, clarifying priorities, tracking progress, and ensuring deadlines and objectives are understood.

  • Support continuous improvement by contributing to new procedures, templates, and process enhancements that improve delivery consistency and customer outcomes.

Basic Qualifications

  • Five or more years of project management experience, preferably managing multiple small to mid-sized customer software projects concurrently without dedicated project teams.

  • Experience executing projects in MS Project and MS Excel.

  • Experience managing software implementation, upgrade, migration, or IT delivery projects through the full project lifecycle.

  • Strong knowledge of project management practices, including project planning, budget tracking, forecasting, risk management, issue management, change control, quality assurance, and delivery governance.

  • Experience working with customer business objectives, critical success factors, contractual requirements, and project performance measures.

  • Experience working within a software development or implementation lifecycle, including requirements, configuration, integration, testing, deployment, and transition to support.

Other Qualifications

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with customers, project teams, leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage many active projects, competing priorities, and frequent context switching.

  • High attention to detail, particularly in meeting minutes, project tracking, financial reporting, invoice approvals, issue follow-up, and risk documentation.

  • Ability to anticipate issues, recommend practical solutions, and drive follow-through to resolution.

  • Customer-focused mindset with the ability to build trust, manage expectations, and support successful project outcomes.

  • Experience with insurance, claims software, or claims administration is preferred.

  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment and contribute to process, template, and procedural improvements.

  • Willingness to work outside standard business hours when required to support project needs or customer commitments.

  • May require occasional travel.

raw.description:
Job Description Summary

The Global CT Portfolio Manager is responsible for building and maintaining a single CT portfolio strategy across the GE HealthCare CT business. CT product marketing is organized into four segments — PCCT, Ultra-Premium, Performance/Value, and Care Area (RT & Cardiac) — with additional coverage for Digital/Smart Subscription. Each segment Director is responsible for segment strategy, roadmap, launch content, and segment P&L.

This role brings those segment plans together into one portfolio strategy: unified portfolio positioning, a consolidated CT launch calendar, and an agreed order of priority across segments. Coordination is the core of the role. The Manager runs the planning cadence, launch sequencing, portfolio messaging architecture, campaign and event execution, budget coordination, and performance reporting required to turn four segment plans into one CT plan, working with the CT segment Directors to reach a shared portfolio view. Responsibilities are divided approximately evenly between portfolio strategy and marketing operations execution. Operational scope includes the CT launch calendar, campaign deployment, exhibits and events coordination, budget tracking, marketing technology, and performance reporting.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

Portfolio Ownership & Cross-Segment Integration

  • Shepherd the development of a cohesive, cross-segment CT portfolio narrative—bringing together the right leaders and teams to connect PCCT, Ultra-Premium, Performance/Value, Care Area, and Digital/Smart Subscription offerings to the needs of distinct customer segments.

  • Maintain the CT portfolio message architecture, ensuring segment positioning ladders up consistently and that new features and NPIs don’t result in gaps or overlaps between segments.

  • Serve as the single point of coordination across the segment Directors, converting peer-to-peer negotiation into a structured prioritization process.

  • Identify portfolio-level whitespace, cannibalization risk, and sequencing conflicts, and bring recommendations with clear trade-offs to the CMO for decision.

  • Ensure CT portfolio marketing activity adheres to healthcare industry regulations, corporate policies, privacy requirements, and brand standards, in alignment with the Downstream Marketing Manager.

Portfolio Planning & Launch Calendar

  • Own one CT portfolio launch calendar covering all segments, eliminating segment launch collisions and competing claims on shared channels, events, and field attention.
  • Run the annual and bi-annual CT marketing planning cadence in partnership with the CMO and segment Directors; consolidate segment inputs into a single portfolio plan aligned to corporate, AIS, regional, and commercial objectives.
  • Sequence launches, campaigns, and content drop against commercial, regional, and congress calendars.
  • Maintain portfolio-level launch readiness tracking and escalate slips early.

Campaign Operations & Performance Management

  • Own CT portfolio performance reporting; prepare portfolio reviews for the CMO and Marketing Leadership Team.
  • Ensure alignment between portfolio marketing objectives, lead generation activity, and commercial outcomes.
  • Partner with Downstream Marketing Manager on attribution, funnel performance analysis, and campaign ROI measurement for CT.

Financial & Resource Management

  • Coordinate the CT portfolio marketing budget process in partnership with Finance, the CMO, and segment Directors; consolidate segment budget inputs into one portfolio view.
  • Tracks spend, maintain forecast accuracy, and provide regular budget and variance reporting across CT marketing activity.
  • Manage ASTs, purchase orders, vendor onboarding, and agency and contract administration for portfolio-level programs.
  • Identify cost optimization and shared-investment opportunities across segments.

Events & Commercial Program Operations

  • Coordinate CT portfolio presence at trade shows, congresses, and customer events in partnership with the AIS exhibits & events team and the Downstream Marketing Manager.
  • Support planning, budgeting, vendor coordination, and logistics management; apply standard operating procedures for event planning and measurement.
  • Report on event effectiveness and business impact at the portfolio level.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of progressive product marketing, portfolio marketing, marketing operations, or commercial operations experience.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating across multiple product lines, segments, or business owners without direct authority.
  • Proven track record managing launch calendars, campaign execution, and marketing program operations end to end.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including preparing executive-level materials.
  • Ability to operate in a matrixed, global environment across multiple time zones.

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience within healthcare technology, medical devices, diagnostic imaging, healthcare IT, or another regulated industry.
  • Familiarity with CT or diagnostic imaging clinical workflows, customer segments, and buying centers.
  • Hands-on experience with marketing automation, CRM, and analytics platforms.
  • Experience supporting global marketing teams and regional commercial organizations.

Document all scheduled tasks that are performed on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis to ensure resource allocation and adequate system performance levels.

10. Provide consultation on data to epidemiologists and analysts. 11. Conduct appropriate analyses, interpreting outputs and providing feedback to the team on related data needs for the project. Our Workers Compensation Lost Time Claims department is seeking a Senior Workers Compensation Adjuster for the California team. This is a Full-time/Exempt role with a fully remote schedule.

POSITION OVERVIEW:

The Senior Workers Compensation Adjuster is responsible for managing moderate to complex and high-value casualty claims with minimal supervision. This role requires advanced investigative and negotiation skills to effectively resolve disputes and handle escalated situations. The Consultant works closely with internal and external experts, including legal counsel and technical specialists, to ensure thorough claim evaluation and resolution. Key responsibilities include representing the company in various forums related to claims litigation, maintaining a high standard of professionalism, and ensuring compliance with regulatory and company standards. The role demands strategic thinking, sound judgment, and the ability to navigate sensitive and high-impact claim scenarios.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

  • Independently manage moderate to complex, high-value casualty claims, ensuring thorough analysis and resolution. Lead thorough investigations, assess coverage, and issue appropriate documentation including reservation of rights and coverage letters. Escalate issues as needed.
  • Identify opportunities to transfer risk and pursue subrogation. Proactively resolve disputes, deescalate sensitive situations, and ensure optimal claim outcomes through strategic negotiation and litigation management.
  • Ensure all claims activities comply with regulatory and company standards. Maintain accurate, detailed records and prepare comprehensive reports. Execute jurisdictional compliance requirements and support others in understanding regulatory obligations.
  • Set reserves, authorize payments, and make financial decisions within authority. Demonstrate strong financial acumen and contribute to reserving accuracy and efficiency.
  • Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders including legal, underwriting, vendors, and agents. Lead cross-functional meetings and communicate complex information clearly to diverse audiences.
  • Use advanced tools and analytics to identify trends, correct inconsistencies, and improve claims handling efficiency. Ensure proper data ingestion, labeling, and protection of personally identifiable information (PII).
  • Serve as a mentor to junior claim handlers, providing guidance on complex claims, compliance, and litigation processes. Support training initiatives and contribute to the development of best practices and educational materials.

WHAT YOU NEED TO APPLY:

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred, or a combination of education and equivalent experience.
  • 5–10+ years of workers compensation claims handling experience with an insurance carrier.
  • Must possess or obtain and maintain appropriate state adjuster licenses and continuing education credits.
  • Skilled in negotiating complex claims and developing strategies to influence outcomes. Demonstrates sound judgment and decision-making on high-exposure cases, including litigation and compliance matters.
  • Communicates clearly and effectively in both verbal and written formats across a variety of situations. Selects appropriate communication channels and consistently demonstrates empathy toward all stakeholders.
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage complex workflows and participate in project work. Demonstrates strong time management and desk management skills, and mentors others in these areas.
  • Possesses in-depth understanding of the regulatory environment and jurisdictional requirements. Handles complex compliance issues and mentors others on regulatory standards.
  • Provides exceptional, empathetic customer service. Effectively manages escalated claims and sensitive customer concerns with professionalism and clarity.
  • Ability to use a personal computer and other standard office equipment.
  • Ability to sit and/or stand for extended periods.
  • Required to work on-site as needed.
  • Ability to travel as necessary.
  • Ability to work in a fast paced, changing or stressful environment.
  • Ability to perform work in a noisy/loud work environment.
  • May be required to have and maintain sufficient home-based internet connection.

The Center for Community Journalism, part of the USA TODAY Network, is seeking a dynamic and forward-thinking candidate to join its operation as a Sports Content Coach in the colleges space. The ideal candidate is an experienced journalist who is capable of editing copy, coaching writers to improve and managing sports journalists. The CCJ is a collection of more than 100 medium- and small-sized newspapers and associated websites in the USA TODAY Network, located geographically from Vermont to Washington state, from California to Florida. Its sports reporters cover local sports, including high school and college sports up to the major conference level. CCJ editors and content coaches manage and direct these journalists to help them best serve the audience available to their communities. The CCJ’s college beat portfolio includes major brands like Alabama, Duke, Florida, Georgia, Indiana, North Carolina, Notre Dame, Texas Tech, UConn and others. The ideal candidate will have AI and automation literacy and a willingness or experience in using it to enhance journalism. This position is remote and can be based anywhere in the US, except for Alaska and Hawaii or based at USA TODAY headquarters in McLean, Va. If you live near one of our local newsrooms, you may have the option to use that as a base of operations.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead a team of writers who cover sports local to their properties. Manage these writers and help them grow through coaching and feedback.
  • Teach them time management and how to identify winning story ideas.
  • Edit copy, often under tight deadlines, from writers across the country, including those who report to other editors and content coaches.
  • Be part of the CCJ’s high schools or colleges coverage leadership team, learning best practices to share with writers and contribute ideas to help improve coverage.
  • Use metrics and analytics to identify what is working in various local audiences and what is not, to best tailor our sports coverage to meet audience.
  • Coordinate and work with the other CCJ sports editors and content coaches, as well as others inside the company.
  • Be willing to work nights, weekends and sometimes holidays as needed.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's in communications, journalism, digital media or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • At least 3 years of experience working in a news organization.
  • Ability to identify stories that sports fans in local markets are talking about and able to leverage those to differentiate in competitive marketplace.
  • Strong news judgment, great communication skills and ability to multi-task in a fast-paced news environment.
  • Demonstrated commitment to producing and promoting journalism that is impactful and authoritative.
  • Experience using analytics to help shape coverage decisions and story execution.
  • Ability to manage, coach and motivate sports journalists to strive for improvement and growth.

Application Instructions:

We are eager to learn more about you and how you fit this role. When you apply, don’t limit your upload to a resume; show us what you’ve done. To do so, put together a single document file that includes the following, in this order:

  • Your resume – one to two pages.
  • A cover letter that outlines how you would approach the job.

It is important that these items be assembled into a single document and uploaded in PDF format. Completing these steps will ensure that your application receives the highest consideration. #Newsgnt

We are a small, agile, and highly collaborative unit focused on delivering strategic mobility, IoT, and SaaS solutions for some of the largest service providers. We move with precision and vitality, relying on strong cross-functional partnerships across product, engineering, sales, customer success, legal, finance, and operations to achieve business outcomes.

We operate with a strong ownership attitude — “you build it, you run it” — where product leaders are encouraged to actively participate in crafting strategy, supporting execution, solving customer challenges, and driving continuous improvement across the product lifecycle.

Your Impact

Serve as the primary Product Lifecycle Manager (PLM) for a Tier-1 U.S. Service Provider, driving the strategic roadmap through 5G-to-6G transitions. You will oversee product lifecycles, scale IoT and Edge AI initiatives, and engage executive collaborators to align Cisco’s cross-functional capabilities with the customer’s long-term business goals.

Strategic Product Leadership

  • Lead end-to-end product lifecycles for mobility, IoT, and emerging technology architectures, including roadmap planning, upgrades, and software releases.
  • Translate complex customer technology requirements into actionable product specifications and execution plans.
  • Drive network evolution from current 5G deployments toward future 5G-Advanced and 6G-ready architectures.

Business Growth and Portfolio Integration

  • Identify and assemble growth opportunities beyond the core contract by developing value propositions in Edge AI, AI inferencing, and mobility infrastructure.
  • Align IoT Control Center business teams, mobility units, and broader Cisco product organizations to deliver a unified service provider value proposition.
  • Build data-backed business cases that connect Cisco technology to measurable customer outcomes.

Executive Communication and Stakeholder Management

  • Engage with senior customer executives and internal leadership to shape strategic positioning and communicate roadmaps.
  • Navigate large, matrixed organizations to influence cross-functional teams and align collaborators toward shared achievements.
  • Operate with high autonomy to handle risks and navigate ambiguous environments optimally.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in product management, product lifecycle management, solution architecture, service provider networking, mobility, IoT, or related technology domains.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related discipline.
  • Experience with mobility technologies and standards, such as; 3GPP, LTE/4G, 5G, 5G-Advanced, and evolving 6G concepts.
  • Experience working with service provider networks, mobility solutions, or large-scale telecom infrastructure.
  • Experience supporting strategic customers and translating customer needs into product requirements and business outcomes.
  • Executive level communication skills such as; presenting to senior leadership, customer executives and cross-functional collaborators.
  • Navigate matrixed organizations to influence teams without direct authority

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with Tier-1 U.S. service providers.
  • Knowledge of Cisco mobility solutions, IoT Control Center, CMP platforms, or service provider SaaS offers.
  • Understanding of emerging technology areas such as AI RAN, Edge AI, AI infrastructure, AI inferencing, and network modernization.
  • Experience building business cases, customer growth strategies, roadmap proposals, or commercial expansion plans.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

raw.description:
About the Team

As part of the Asset Protection department, you will help protect the company’s people, property, and profitability. The team plays a critical role in minimizing loss, identifying risks, and supporting a safe environment for associates and customers. Asset Protection team members are recognized for strong investigative and analytical skills, clear communication, process-driven thinking, and effective partnerships across departments and with outside agencies.

About the Role

The Asset Protection Investigator is a highly organized, detail-oriented, and motivated professional who helps protect company assets and reduce risk across all brands and channels by using strong investigative and analytical skills to identify fraud, theft, policy violations, and Asset Protection concerns through EBR systems, transaction review, AI-assisted analysis, social networking platforms, incident reporting, ad hoc queries, and department reports. This role conducts timely investigations, develops case summaries, compiles documentation, and prepares investigative findings for the Asset Protection team, internal business partners such as Legal and HR, and, when appropriate, outside agencies including law enforcement and financial institutions. The Investigator also maintains department files and records in accordance with company standards and supports daily and weekly responsibilities, including case reporting, case auditing, PCI compliance hotlines, and CCPA review.

We’re excited about you because...

  • Own It: Proactively analyze and investigate associate and customer activity across retail stores and online channels to identify fraud, policy violations, and Asset Protection concerns using exception-based reporting, AI-assisted analysis, and department reporting.
  • Drive for Results: Conduct thorough investigations across all brands and channels into suspected internal and external fraud, theft, and policy violations, ensuring timely and objective case resolution.
  • Communicate with Clarity: Prepare and deliver accurate, well-documented investigations for the Asset Protection team and other internal departments such as Legal, HR, and, when appropriate, law enforcement partners or financial institutions.
  • Own It: Maintain department files, records, and investigative documentation in accordance with company standards and record-keeping requirements, while completing daily and weekly duties including case reporting, case auditing, PCI compliance hotlines, and CCPA review.
  • Communicate with Clarity: Document case activity and maintain accurate case management records to support trend analysis, statistical reporting, and senior leadership updates.
  • Achieve as One Team: Provide investigative support and expertise to Asset Protection Managers, Directors, the Vice President, and cross-functional partners including Legal, HR, and Risk Management to address complex risk-related issues.
  • Put People First: Build and maintain trusted relationships with internal business partners, law enforcement, financial institutions, associates, and customers while managing sensitive and confidential information with professionalism and discretion.
  • Create Solutions: Review systems and documentation to identify gaps, ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and Asset Protection standards, and recommend opportunities for improvement.
  • Create Solutions: Develop ad hoc queries, AI prompts, reports, and case summaries using data management and reporting tools to support investigations and informed decision-making.
  • Drive for Results: Complete special projects and additional responsibilities with urgency, adaptability, and commitment to departmental goals.

Technical Competencies Required

  • Minimum of 5-10 years of experience in Asset Protection, retail, or care center environment.
  • Strong intermediate database and spreadsheet management skills, including Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and MicroStrategy.
  • Knowledge of social networking platforms and basic online investigative tools preferred but not required.
  • Experienced in AI-assisted analysis and reporting, is a plus.
  • Experience with exception-based reporting systems, such as Appriss Secure 5, is a plus.
  • Wicklander integrity interview certification preferred but not required.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to sit for prolonged periods of time.
  • Ability to type on a keyboard and operate a PC.
  • Ability to communicate by telephone, Zoom and Teams.
  • Ability to work remotely.

Why you will love working at Williams-Sonoma, Inc.

  • A successful, fast-growing company with an entrepreneurial mindset
  • A technology- and data-driven business
  • Competitive salaries and comprehensive health benefits
  • A company at the forefront of technology and retail, redefining experience for the next generation
  • A team passionate about internal and external clients and committed to the client experience
  • Opportunities to be creative every day
  • A smart, experienced leadership team committed to doing things the right way and open to new ideas
  • A culture that values autonomy and rewards initiative
  • A team that works hard and enjoys what we do

Benefits:

Once you are here, you can look forward to a wide range of benefits designed to support your personal and professional growth, health, family, and future. Depending on your position and location, you may be eligible for:

  • A generous discount across all Williams-Sonoma, Inc. brands through multiple shopping channels
  • A 401(k) plan and other investment opportunities
  • Paid vacation, holidays, and other time-off programs
  • Health benefits, including medical, dental, and vision insurance; health and dependent care tax-free spending accounts; medical, family, and bereavement leave; domestic partner benefits; short- and long-term disability programs; life and travel insurance; and an employee assistance program
  • Tax-free commuter benefits

  • In-person and online learning opportunities through WSI University
  • Cross-brand and cross-functional career opportunities
  • Location-specific sample sales
  • A business casual work environment

In our Service Supply Chain offering, we leverage a combination of proprietary technology and client systems to develop, execute, and deliver BPaaS (business process as a service) or Managed Service solutions across the service lifecycle: Plan, Deliver, and Recover.

Join our dynamic Service Supply Chain (SSC) team and be at the forefront of helping world class organizations unlock their full potential.

We are currently seeking to hire a Product Management Specialist. This role owns the full product lifecycle — from setting strategy, vision, and roadmap to driving delivery across one or more digital domains.

The Product Management Specialist works cross-functionally with engineering, architecture, and business stakeholders to translate complex problems into clear product requirements and ship solutions in Agile environments. They measure and grow product impact through KPIs, analytics, and continuous discovery, while identifying opportunities for new digital offerings and market expansion.

Other responsibilities include:

  • Strategy & Vision Own product strategy, vision, roadmap, and delivery across digital domains; identify opportunities for new digital offerings, revenue growth, and market expansion.

  • Discovery & Stakeholder Engagement Lead product discovery sessions, stakeholder workshops, and requirements gathering to surface and align on customer needs and business priorities.

  • Requirements Definition Define and prioritize product requirements; translate business problems into detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, and product specifications.

  • Technical Collaboration Partner with architecture and engineering teams to assess technical feasibility and evaluate solution options.

  • Agile Delivery & Launch Drive product development from concept through deployment in Agile environments; support releases and adoption activities to ensure successful go-to-market execution.

  • Performance & Continuous Improvement Measure product success through business, customer, and operational KPIs; leverage user feedback, experimentation, and analytics to drive ongoing iteration and improvement.

Success in This Role:
This role is designed to drive the creation and launch of new digital products and services that deliver measurable business value. Within the first 2 years, the Product Manager will be expected to lead at least one net-new product or significant product capability from concept to market launch and support user onboarding and adoption efforts.
Success will be evaluated based on product delivery, launch execution, customer adoption, business impact, stakeholder satisfaction, and contribution to the broader product portfolio.

As business priorities evolve, career growth opportunities may include continued product ownership, expansion into larger product domains, or transition into other roles aligned to the individual's strengths and organizational needs as necessary.

You will be successful if you can:

  • Deliver products that solve meaningful customer problems.

  • Improve product adoption and measurable business outcomes.

  • Align business, technology, and operational stakeholders.

  • Create scalable, reusable digital capabilities.

  • Identify new growth opportunities and product innovations.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree.

  • Minimum of 6 years of experience in Product Management.

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience managing SaaS or enterprise software products.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Engineering degree in the fields of electrical or mechanical engineering.

  • Experience with Supply Chain, Service Lifecycle Management, Logistics, Aftermarket Services, Asset Management, Field Service, or Operations Technology.

  • Experience launching new digital products.

  • Experience working with Agile delivery teams.

  • Familiarity with AI, automation, analytics, or workflow orchestration solutions.

  • Exposure to enterprise integrations, APIs, and cloud platforms.

  • Ability to create and manage product roadmaps.

  • Consulting experience is a plus.

Professional Skills Requirements:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

raw.description:
Marsello helps retailers know their customers and keep them coming back. We're growing across APAC, and we're looking for an Account Executive to help us win the next wave of retail brands.

You'll begin with a real head start. There's a steady flow of inbound leads from retailers who already want to talk. The challenge, and the fun, is going out and finding the ones who don't know about us yet. You'll convert inbound interest, build your own pipeline through outbound, and run demos that uncover needs retailers didn't know they had. You'll do it alongside a supportive, high-energy sales team that's in your corner.

If you know your way around SaaS, love the chase as much as the close, and want targets you can actually beat with a product retailers genuinely need, this is a role where you'll have the leads to hit your number and the freedom to smash it.

What you'll own

Inbound that's ready to go. Retailers come to us looking for a better way to keep their customers coming back. You'll pick up those leads, qualify them quickly, and turn warm interest into signed customers.

Outbound that's yours to grow. Beyond the inbound flow, you'll go after the retailers who should be on Marsello but aren't yet. You'll decide who to target, start the conversation, and build a pipeline that wouldn't exist without you. This is where great AEs make their mark.

The first conversation. For most prospective customers, you'll be their first real experience of Marsello. You'll run the demos, present the product, and ask the questions that get to what a retailer actually needs.

Your numbers. You'll carry a target and be trusted to hit it, and then to beat it, with a sales team that shares what works and celebrates the wins.

What we're looking for

  • A proven sales track record of hitting and beating targets, ideally in SaaS, retail, loyalty or marketing.
  • The discipline to work inbound leads quickly and well, and the drive to build outbound pipelines from scratch.
  • Natural confidence presenting and running demos online.
  • A tidy, well-run pipeline in a CRM.
  • A strong appreciation for technology, ideally marketing automation, cloud or SaaS, and genuine curiosity about how retailers use digital and marketing tools.
  • Excellent communication, both in writing and out loud.
  • A team-first attitude. You want to be part of a high-velocity sales team, not just a solo operator.

Why Marsello

We're a smart, close-knit team spread across New Zealand, Canada and Australia, and we back people to own their space. This role is remote, ideally based in Wellington.

Beyond the work itself, you'll get genuine flexibility in your working day, subsidised Southern Cross healthcare, a wellness allowance, a technology allowance, and even a day off for your birthday.

If you want a sales role with warm leads to work, new ground to break, and a team that has your back, we'd love to hear from you.

Clinical Trial Manager, Clinical Operations

The Clinical Trial Manager, Clinical Operations is responsible for the oversight, planning and delivery of assigned clinical study(ies) within the RayzeBio programs, including oversight and management of the study Clinical Research Organization (CRO) and Vendors according to and in compliance with corporate and program Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Good Clinical Practice (GCP)/International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines and other applicable federal (FDA) and state regulations, in order to achieve established study goals within timelines and budget and of the highest quality.

  • Plan and execute study timelines

raw.description:
The IT Project Manager is responsible for leading the end-to-end delivery of a strategic Disaster Recovery (DR) and cyber resilience program across APAC and Europe. The role focuses on establishing and expanding regional DR capabilities, enabling recovery of business-critical applications, and introducing recovery automation to improve resilience, recovery speed, and failover readiness. The Project Manager coordinates infrastructure, network, security, application, and business stakeholders to ensure critical services can be recovered within agreed recovery objectives following major disruptions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of Disaster Recovery and cyber resilience initiatives across multiple regions and sites.
  • Manage the establishment of an in-region co-location DR facility, including network connectivity, storage, Nutanix, VMware, firewalls, and application onboarding.
  • Coordinate DR enablement and recovery readiness for business-critical applications, including recovery planning, testing, and site failover exercises.
  • Drive implementation of Ansible-based recovery automation, including automated technical runbooks and recovery playbooks.
  • Manage related cyber resilience initiatives, including Citrix modernization, Azure MFA, malware protection, and remediation of identified security findings.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams across Infrastructure, Network, Security, Applications, Business Continuity, vendors, and regional/site stakeholders.
  • Own project planning, budget, resources, dependencies, RAID management, governance, and executive status reporting.
  • Ensure DR solutions are successfully tested, documented, transitioned to operations, and capable of meeting defined recovery objectives.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of IT project management experience, preferably in Disaster Recovery, infrastructure, cybersecurity, or business continuity projects.
  • Strong understanding of Disaster Recovery concepts, business continuity, recovery testing, failover, and enterprise infrastructure.
  • Experience in regulated pharmaceutical environments (GxP documentation).
  • Experience managing infrastructure projects involving technologies such as VMware, Nutanix, storage, networking, firewalls, and co-location/data center environments.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure automation and recovery orchestration; experience with Ansible is highly advantageous.
  • Understanding of cybersecurity technologies such as MFA, malware protection, Citrix, and security remediation.
  • Proven experience managing global or multi-site projects, technical vendors, risks, budgets, and cross-functional delivery teams.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication, governance, and executive reporting skills.

raw.title: Senior Data Engineer
raw.excerpt: Why Valtech?  We’retheexperience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands.
raw.description:
Why Valtech? We’retheexperience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

  • The work we do and the innovation we drive
  • Our values of share, care and dare
  • A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
  • Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and optimize modern, cloud-based data platforms that power analytics, AI, and data products across the organization. Beyond technical delivery, we're looking for someone genuinely curious about the business problems behind the data — someone who can apply common sense thinking, detailed analysis, and experience-based recommendations to help derive and shape business requirements, not just implement them as given.

You will work on scalable batch, streaming, and near-real-time pipelines, enabling high-quality, curated datasets while ensuring robust data governance, security, and observability across the data ecosystem. You will also play a key role in supporting AI and GenAI systems, enabling pipelines for machine learning, causal modeling, and LLM-powered applications such as RAG and agent-based systems.

This role can be delivered on either of our two core cloud ecosystems — AWS (with Databricks) or Azure/Fabric (with Databricks or native Fabric tooling) — and you'll be staffed on projects that match your strongest platform. You don't need experience in both. Additional experience across Snowflake or GCP is considered a strong plus.

You will collaborate closely with data scientists, ML engineers, and platform teams to ensure the data foundation supports production-grade, decision-oriented AI systems.

Role responsibilities

Build & Data Platform Engineering

Design and implement scalable data platforms and pipelines on whichever of our two core ecosystems matches your strengths — AWS (with Databricks) or Azure/Fabric (with Databricks or native Fabric tooling) — with exposure to other environments (Snowflake, GCP) considered a plus. This includes developing reliable batch, streaming, and near-real-time pipelines using technologies such as Spark and Delta Lake, and building ingestion, transformation, and curation workflows for both structured and unstructured data.

You will implement modern data architectures including lakehouse patterns and medallion layering (bronze, silver, gold) within Databricks or Fabric, ensuring systems are reusable, scalable, and aligned with enterprise needs.

Enable AI, GenAI & Data Products

Deliver high-quality datasets that support analytics, machine learning, causal modeling, and optimization systems. You will enable data pipelines for GenAI use cases (including LLMs, RAG pipelines, and vector-based data flows), as well as agent-based architectures and intelligent workflows, ensuring that data is model-ready and production-grade — leveraging Databricks' MLflow and Unity Catalog, or the equivalent Azure/Fabric and Azure ML tooling, depending on the platform you work in.

Data Modeling, Orchestration & Automation

Design scalable logical and physical data models for analytical and operational use cases, ensuring consistency across domains. Orchestrate workflows using tools such as Airflow, dbt, Databricks Workflows, Azure Data Factory, or equivalents, with strong focus on automation, reliability, and maintainability of end-to-end pipelines.

Architecture, Governance & Observability

Apply modern architecture patterns including event-driven and streaming architectures, and ensure adherence to best practices in data governance, lineage, quality, and access control (RBAC/ABAC), using tools such as Unity Catalog and AWS Lake Formation, or Microsoft Purview, depending on the platform in use.

Establish strong data observability, including monitoring of data freshness, pipeline reliability, and SLA adherence, ensuring systems remain trustworthy and production-ready.

Data Serving, Integration & Optimization

Enable data serving layers (APIs, feature inputs, analytical endpoints) to support downstream systems, including ML and AI platforms. Continuously monitor and optimize pipelines and infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency across our core cloud ecosystems.

Requirements Discovery & Business Partnership

Bring genuine curiosity to every engagement — ask the right questions to understand not just what stakeholders are asking for, but why. Apply common sense thinking, detailed analysis, and experience-based recommendations to help derive and refine business requirements, surfacing gaps or better alternatives where they exist rather than simply executing a brief as written.

Collaboration

Work closely with data scientists, ML engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into robust data solutions. Support adoption of data products and contribute to best practices across the data and AI ecosystem.

Must have qualifications

Technical skills

Strong hands-on experience with Apache Spark and Delta Lake, and strong programming skills in Python and SQL. Proven experience building batch and streaming data pipelines and production-grade data platforms, with solid understanding of data modeling, data quality, and governance principles.

Cloud & Platforms (Key Requirement) — choose your track:

  • Track A: Strong, demonstrable hands-on experience with AWS data services (e.g., S3, Glue, EMR, Redshift, Kinesis, Lambda) and the Databricks Lakehouse Platform
  • Track B: Strong, demonstrable hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure / Fabric (e.g., Data Factory, Synapse, Fabric Lakehouse, Azure Databricks)

You only need deep expertise in one track — we treat both as equally weighted core platforms and will align you to projects based on where your experience is strongest. Familiarity with other modern data platforms such as Snowflake or GCP is a plus but not required.

Architecture & Systems Thinking

Experience with lakehouse architectures and distributed data systems, and strong understanding of scalability, reliability, and performance considerations in data pipelines.

Mindset

Naturally curious, with strong problem-solving skills focused on scalability and reliability, and a collaborative approach to working in cross-functional teams. Comfortable applying common sense thinking, detailed analysis, and experience-based recommendations to help derive and challenge business requirements rather than taking them at face value. Experience in Agile or consulting environments is beneficial.

Nice to have qualifications

Deep expertise in both tracks — AWS and Azure/Fabric, across Databricks and native Fabric tooling — is a strong plus, though not required, as is experience with GenAI and AI data systems (e.g., RAG pipelines, vector databases, LLM data preparation), CI/CD for data pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.

Additional exposure to streaming technologies (e.g., Kafka), Spark optimization, or advanced analytics and ML workloads (including causal or experimentation platforms) is valuable. Experience building data products or large-scale analytics platforms is also beneficial.

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

The benefits

  • Private health insurance
    We hope you will never need it, but nevertheless, we offer private health insurance to all our employees.

  • Education program
    We never stop learning, that’s why we offer our employees an educational program with training and certification.

  • Wellbeing program
    We all deserve to live a healthy and well-balanced life. It's not an option, it's a necessity!

  • Free beverages
    Enjoy free coffee, drinks, and snacks at work, or join one of our famous company dinners.

  • Events
    We enjoy spending time together, not only at work. Ski trips, carting, laser-tag, wine tasting, picnics, cooking classes… you name it – we’ve done it! There are plenty of cool events to join and to get to know your colleagues.

  • Competitive conditions
    Besides a competitive salary and 24 days of vacation, you will join annual company events with the whole team.

  • Challenging projects
    Ready for a challenge? We guarantee you'll find challenging projects at Valtech!
  • Cool colleagues
    What's the most important thing in a job? Cool colleagues with whom you spent most of the time during the week. We have a lot of them!
  • Honest feedback
    Honesty, openness and respect are among our core values. We encourage an open feedback culture in order to build trust and grow together.

Your application process

About The Role
Brighton Health Plan Solutions (BHPS) provides Case Management services to its clients. Cases are maintained by Case Managers. The employee reports directly to the Supervisor, Case Management (LCSW). In addition, the role maintains a dotted-line relationship to the Senior Director, Case Management (RN) for clinical guidance, nursing practice standards, and case management program oversight. This position is also responsible for assuring appropriate systems are in place to collect and report program activities and outcomes for case management programs. 
This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities, and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

Primary Responsibilities
  • Conduct comprehensive assessments to identify medical, behavioral health, psychosocial, functional, and care coordination needs.
  • Develop, implement, monitor, and update individualized, member-centered care plans in collaboration with members, caregivers, providers, and interdisciplinary teams.
  • Coordinate care across the healthcare continuum to promote quality outcomes, appropriate utilization, member engagement, and cost-effective care.
  • Provide education and coaching to members and caregivers regarding health conditions, treatment plans, medications, preventive care, and self-management strategies.
  • Identify and address barriers to care, treatment adherence, health equity, and achievement of care plan goals.
  • Facilitate transitions of care and support timely access to medical, behavioral health, and community-based services.
  • Perform ongoing outreach, monitoring, reassessment, and follow-up to evaluate progress toward goals and modify care plans as needed.
  • Collaborate with members, caregivers, providers, and community resources to support coordination of care and continuity of services.
  • Utilize evidence-based guidelines, clinical criteria, nursing judgment, and care management best practices to support clinical decision-making and interventions.
  • Identify gaps in care, emerging risks, and opportunities for intervention to improve member outcomes and reduce avoidable utilization.
  • Present complex cases during interdisciplinary case reviews and participate in collaborative care planning and problem-solving activities.
  • Collaborate with Utilization Management, Population Health, Behavioral Health, Medical Directors, and other internal and external stakeholders to support integrated care delivery.
  • Maintain accurate, timely, and complete documentation of assessments, care plans, interventions, member progress, and coordination activities in accordance with organizational, regulatory, and accreditation standards.
  • Ensure compliance with NCQA Care Management standards, HIPAA requirements, applicable state and federal regulations, and organizational policies and procedures.
  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives, audits, accreditation activities, performance improvement projects, and ongoing professional development.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Essential Qualifications
  • Current, active, unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license required.
  • Compact (Multistate) Nursing Licensure is required. New York State RN licensure is highly preferred. Candidates who do not currently hold a New York State RN license must be willing and able to obtain NYS licensure within thirty (30) days of hire. The incumbent must maintain all licenses and credentials required to perform the responsibilities of the position.
  • Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) preferred; Associate Degree in Nursing (ADN) with relevant experience considered.
  • Minimum two (2) years of nursing experience in case management, care management, population health, behavioral health, managed care, utilization management, or a related clinical setting; behavioral health experience preferred.
  • Experience in behavioral health case management, psychiatric nursing, substance use disorder treatment, integrated care, or coordination of behavioral health services preferred.
  • Demonstrated clinical knowledge in assessment, care planning, chronic condition management, behavioral health integration, and care coordination.
  • Experience conducting comprehensive clinical assessments and developing individualized, member-centered care plans.
  • Knowledge of care management principles, healthcare delivery systems, community resources, and behavioral health service systems.
  • Understanding of NCQA Care Management standards, care coordination best practices, and applicable state and federal regulatory requirements.
  • Strong clinical assessment, medical record review, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to identify care gaps, barriers to care, and opportunities to improve member outcomes.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage members, caregivers, providers, and interdisciplinary teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize workload, manage multiple assignments, and work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and experience working within electronic medical record, case management, and database systems.
  • Commitment to maintaining member confidentiality and compliance with HIPAA and other applicable regulations.
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities and support organizational goals, quality initiatives, and accreditation requirements.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN).
  • Certified Case Manager (CCM), Accredited Case Manager (ACM), Behavioral Health certification, or other relevant certification preferred.
  • Experience in managed care, Medicare, Medicaid, commercial health plans, or population health programs.
  • Experience working within an NCQA-accredited health plan and applying NCQA Care Management standards, including assessment, care planning, care coordination, transitions of care, and ongoing member monitoring, strongly preferred.
  • Knowledge of evidence-based care management practices, motivational interviewing, and member engagement strategies.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and decision-making skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams and with community-based providers and resources.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities.

Forts de 250 consultant.e.s combinant des expertises sectorielles et technologiques uniques, nous sommes en capacité d’intervenir de bout en bout :

  • Sur l’ensemble de la chaine de valeur, de la vente aux opérations (finance, supply chain)
  • Sur l’ensemble des aspects métiers, fonctionnels, applicatifs et technologiques
  • De la stratégie au pilotage de la transformation, en préparant le futur modèle d’opération agile

Nous créons de la valeur de façon durable, grâce à notre Positive Way, en privilégiant toujours la simplicité et le pragmatisme.

Nous sommes indépendants, tout en entretenant de forts liens opérationnels avec les principaux leaders du marché pour rester en permanence à l’état de l’art. 

Dans un environnement où l’innovation technologique s’accélère, la capacité à transformer rapidement une idée en solution opérationnelle est devenue un enjeu stratégique pour les entreprises. L’essor des outils d’intelligence artificielle (IA) ouvre de nouvelles perspectives pour automatiser et accélérer le développement applicatif. Ces solutions promettent de réduire drastiquement le temps de conception et de mise en production, mais leurs performances réelles restent à évaluer.

Le stage s’inscrit dans cette dynamique : tester si les outils IA disponibles fin 2025 permettent de passer efficacement de l’idée à une application web déployable en production, et dans quelle mesure ils peuvent se substituer aux approches traditionnelles ou low-code.

Objectif du stage

Encadré.e par un.e chef.fe de projet expérimenté.e, vous aurez pour mission de réaliser un benchmark opérationnel des solutions IA orientées développement applicatif. Ce benchmark se déroulera en deux étapes :

  • Analyse théorique : étude comparative des principales solutions du marché (fonctionnalités, interopérabilité, coûts, contraintes techniques).
  • Expérimentation pratique : sélection de 4 solutions pour concevoir et développer une application web avec chacune d’elles. L’application réalisée sera choisie en fonction des besoins internes ou d’avant-vente (exemple : outil support pour un événement, maquette fonctionnelle pour un projet). Outre le développement, ce sera aussi l’occasion de mettre à l’épreuve / développer vos compétences UX

À l’issue de ces travaux, vous produirez une analyse critique de la qualité du code généré, des performances et de la facilité de déploiement, afin de formuler des recommandations concrètes sur les meilleures solutions à adopter.

Une question complémentaire pourra être explorée : les solutions IA peuvent-elles remplacer les plateformes low-code en termes de rapidité, sécurité et intégration dans un SI d’entreprise ?

En bref, l’objectif est d’avoir développé à l’issu du stage une compréhension fine de comment l’IA permet d’être efficient dans le développement informatique, et une conviction sur les meilleurs outils à utiliser.

En parallèle, vous serez pleinement intégré.e à la vie interne du cabinet et pourrez contribuer, selon vos appétences, à :

  • L’animation et le développement des offres de l’expertise Supply Chain ;
  • La rédaction de contenus à destination de nos blogs et supports de communication ;
  • Le développement de nos assets internes (Shake'Up, CréaDesk, Research & Knowledge Center) ;
  • Les initiatives de recrutement, de relations écoles et de formation ;
  • La mise en œuvre de la stratégie RSE de Wavestone.

Travaux à réaliser

Le ou la stagiaire contribuera activement à l’enrichissement de l’offre interne de Wavestone autour de l’IA appliquée au développement logiciel :

  1. Réaliser un état des lieux du marché : identification des solutions IA orientées développement web, analyse de leurs caractéristiques et positionnement.
  2. Élaborer un benchmark théorique : comparaison des avantages et limites des solutions (rapidité, qualité du code, interopérabilité avec outils comme Figma, coût).
  3. Sélectionner 4 solutions et développer une application web avec chacune : mise en œuvre concrète pour tester la capacité à passer de l’idée à la production.
  4. Évaluer la qualité des livrables : analyse du code généré, robustesse, maintenabilité, sécurité et facilité de déploiement.
  5. Produire un rapport de recommandations : synthèse des résultats, classement des solutions et propositions pour leur usage futur.
  6. Optionnel : définir un cadre permettant d’intégrer ces solutions IA dans une stratégie de remplacement ou complément des outils low-code.

Étudiant.e au sein d'une grande école d'ingénieurs avec une spécialisation en ingénierie logicielle, vous êtes attiré.e par le conseil et vous possédez une forte appétence pour les sujets de transformation digitale au sein d’entreprises leaders de leur secteur.

Vous souhaitez développer des compétences liées au métier du conseil et aux problématiques de transformation des organisations, tout en conservant un pied solidement ancré dans les sujets de développement informatique.

Vos atouts :

  • Doté.e d’une véritable appétence pour les sujets techniques, vous avez des connaissances en développement et maîtrisez les bases de l’algorithmie
  • « Expérimenter », « entreprendre », « innover » sont des mots importants pour vous ; avoir réalisé un projet de dév en dehors du cadre des cours sera un bonus appréciable
  • Orientation client, excellent relationnel et sens du service seront des atouts importants pour cadrer les spécifications des applications à réaliser ; justifier de connaissances en UX serait un plus
  • Enfin, précision, rigueur, organisation, autonomie et esprit de synthèse seront autant de qualificatifs appréciés pour mener à bien ce stage

Par ailleurs, vous voulez être acteur.rice d'un projet d'entreprise ambitieux en pleine croissance en France et à l'international. Vous avez envie de mettre votre enthousiasme au service d'un cabinet qui saura vous proposer une prise de responsabilités rapide.

Wavestone est un employeur inclusif qui s'engage pour l'égalité des chances. Dans le cadre de cette politique de diversité et inclusion, Wavestone accompagne les personnes en situation de handicap et/ou nécessitant un aménagement durant leur process de recrutement et tout au long de leur prise de poste.

Rejoignez un cabinet de conseil international qui accompagne les grandes transformations stratégiques.

Nous sommes Wavestone : des expert·es passionné·es et orienté·es solutions, qui placent l’humain au cœur de la performance et de la croissance. Ambitieux·ses et en pleine expansion, nous développons sans cesse notre portefeuille de clients et de projets, avec une portée internationale et une réelle volonté de générer un impact positif.

Êtes-vous un vrai team player, porté par des valeurs fortes ? Êtes-vous curieux·se et déterminé·e, avec l’envie d’apprendre chaque jour ? Êtes-vous du genre à relever les défis sans hésiter ? Alors vous êtes au bon endroit. Rejoignez Wavestone et exprimez votre potentiel dans un environnement stimulant et collaboratif, où l’on transforme les défis d’aujourd’hui en opportunités de demain.

Job Title: ﻿Programmatic Associate (Remote)

About the Client: ﻿a performance marketing agency specializing in healthy, active, and lifestyle brands. The company helps businesses drive growth through data-driven marketing, audience insights, media strategy, creative content, and integrated digital solutions.

Overview: ﻿The Programmatic Associate is a hands-on execution and account health role supporting the Programmatic team. This position builds and traffics programmatic campaigns quickly and accurately, keeps live campaigns delivering on budget, and finds problems before they cost clients money. Unlike a pure QA role, the associate is expected to diagnose what is wrong and propose a specific fix, not just flag that something looks off. The associate works from documented processes, build templates, and briefs from senior team members. Recommended fixes are reviewed and approved by the Programmatic Team Manager before changes that affect strategy, bidding, inventory, or budget allocation are made. This role is not responsible for leading client communication, setting campaign strategy, or owning client performance goals

Responsibilities:

  • Build campaigns in The Trade Desk and DV360 from approved briefs and templates, including budgets, flights, ad groups or line items, bid settings, frequency caps, audiences, geo targeting, and brand safety settings
  • Primary focus will be The Trade Desk. Secondary will be DV360, including YouTube line items
  • Traffic creatives and tags, confirming correct specs, sizes, VAST/VPAID setup, click-through URLs, and UTMs
  • Set up and verify deal IDs, private marketplace (PMP) deals, and inventory lists
  • Confirm tracking pixels and conversion events are firing and attached correctly before launch
  • Build multi-location geo targeting quickly for clients operating dozens to hundreds of locations
  • Run scheduled audits of live campaigns against a standard checklist: flight dates, budgets, pacing settings, frequency caps, creative approvals, deal status, pixel health, and naming consistency
  • Perform daily delivery checks using internal tools and directly in platform to spot anomalies such as under-delivery, sudden spend spikes, falling win rates, CPM or CTR swings, viewability drops, or conversion tracking breaks
  • Identify the likely cause of each anomaly (for example, bids too low for the inventory, an inactive or non-bidding deal, an expired creative, a pixel outage, overly narrow targeting, or suspicious traffic) before escalating
  • Review site and app placement reports to flag low-quality or suspicious inventory and propose exclusions
  • For every issue identified, document what happened, the likely cause, the recommended fix, and the expected impact
    Implement approved fixes and routine corrections (creative swaps, broken URLs, flight date fixes, placement exclusions) within agreed guidelines
  • Escalate issues that affect strategy, bidding, inventory, or budget allocation to the
  • Programmatic Team Manager with a recommendation, not just a flag
  • Monitor campaign pacing to ensure budgets are spending appropriately relative to plan; flag under- or over-delivery promptly
  • Verify landing pages, URLs, and destination functionality prior to and after launch
  • Clearly communicate errors, risks, and pacing concerns to senior team members
  • Track identified issues through resolution to ensure no gaps in execution
  • Build CTV and audio campaigns from approved briefs
  • Own recurring audits for an assigned set of clients end to end
  • Implement a wider range of approved optimizations (bid adjustments, budget shifts within plan, inventory and audience refinements) with less review
  • Help maintain and improve build templates, audit checklists, and anomaly thresholds
  • Support a higher volume of campaigns once consistency and trust are established﻿

Qualifications:

  • Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience building and managing campaigns in The Trade Desk
  • Experience trafficking creatives and tags, including display and video (VAST) formats
  • Working knowledge of bidding, frequency management, audience and geo targeting, deals and PMPs, and brand safety and fraud prevention tools
  • Understanding of pixel and conversion tracking, including Google Tag Manager and Campaign Manager 360
  • Demonstrated ability to diagnose the cause of a delivery or performance change, not just notice it
  • The Trade Desk Edge Academy certification preferred; DV360 experience not required (training provided)
  • Strong attention to detail and comfort with process-driven, high-volume work
  • Ability to work quickly without sacrificing accuracy and to meet deadlines consistently
  • Clear written communication skills for internal coordination and issue write-ups

Bureau Veritas offers dynamic, exciting employment opportunities with an attractive salary/benefit package and an opportunity to play a vital role with a global organization. If you would enjoy working in a dynamic environment and are looking for an opportunity to become part of a stellar team of professionals, we invite you to apply online today.

Bureau Veritas is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and as such we recruit, hire, train, and promote persons in all job classifications without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, sexual orientation, genetics, status as a protected veteran, or any other non-job-related characteristics.

This position is responsible to ensure equal opportunity in employment in that all persons are treated equally and on the basis of merit, in decisions regarding selection, placement, promotions, training, work assignments, transfers and other personnel actions.

City: Remote

State: Remote

Job Summary:

The Commissioning Agent will be responsible for commissioning, retro-commissioning, and/or monitoring-based commissioning of projects. The scope of work may also include facilities condition assessments, construction administration, plan review, and plan checks for Bureau Veritas Architecture & Engineering.

The Commissioning Agent must be capable of managing projects from concept through construction while effectively interfacing with clients, contractors, and facility operations personnel. The ideal Commissioning Agent candidate will be able to fully communicate and address client problems/questions/comments in a clear, professional manner. He/she will develop the commissioning plan, prepare pre-functional check lists, develop functional performance test procedures, oversee functional performance testing, and develop the final commissioning report for the commissioning scope of work.

The Commissioning Agent will act as the designated agent to complete the commissioning scope of services.

The objective of commissioning is to provide documented confirmation that a facility fulfills the functional and performance requirements of the owner, designer, occupants, and operators. To reach this goal, it is necessary for the Commissioning Agent to establish and document the criteria for system function, performance, and maintainability; as well as to verify and document compliance with these criteria.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

On a commissioning assignment, the Commissioning Agent shall conduct the following tasks (as applicable):

  • Act as the commissioning authority.
  • Review the design to become familiar with the design criteria and expected performance.
  • Provide design review comments as they affect the commissioning process.
  • Develop a commissioning plan.
  • Conduct commissioning meetings.
  • Review submittals during construction as they affect the commissioning process.
  • Verify installation and functional performance of the following:
    • HVAC systems
    • Building automation systems
    • Lighting control systems
    • Plumbing domestic hot water systems
    • Other system as required
  • Develop pre-functional test procedures.
  • Oversee the functional testing and complete the functional testing forms.
  • Complete and submit a commissioning report.
  • Oversee Contractor-provided operator training and review training materials.
  • Complete warranty phase commissioning follow-up

Qualifications:

Education and/or Experience:

  • Preferred: Accredited Professional Degree in Engineering
  • Required: Minimum five years professional experience within construction realm.
  • Required: 5+ years of experience specifically in commissioning, including experience with commissioning of comparable projects in size and complexity.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:

  • Required:Accredited Commissioning Certification such as CxA (Certified Commissioning Authority), CCP (Certified Commissioning Professional) or BCxP (Building Commissioning Professional)
  • Preferred: Professional Engineer licensure (any state)
  • Valid driver's license is required with no significant MVA points/violations (clean driving record).

Other qualifications:

  • Must have expertise in working with commissioning software like Facility Grid and CxAlloy.
  • Proficient in all Microsoft Office applications with a strong emphasis in MS Excel.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent time management skills including ability to perform multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment and ability to work independently.
  • You can traverse, observe equipment, and record data and photos on safely accessible roofs and other high or open areas, which may require ladder and/or hatch access.
  • You are comfortable and willing to work in densely equipped mechanical and electrical spaces requiring dedicated focus on safety protocol.
  • Ability to travel up to 30% to client sites.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

There are no supervisory responsibilities associated with this role.

Skills:

Language Ability

  • Ability to draft reports, business correspondence, and standard operating procedures.
  • Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from clients, peers, and technical field staff.

Reasoning Ability

  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
  • Ability to interpret an extensive variety of instructions and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

Technology Skills

  • To perform this job successfully, an individual must be proficient in operating a computer, having knowledge of word processing software, spreadsheet software, and project management software, to include Facility Grid and CxAlloy, Advanced Excel, Microsoft Suite and business specific software and other project specific applications.
  • To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to operate an electronic tablet in the field for live data collection.

Knowledge, Skills, and Other Abilities

  • Understanding construction materials and methods, environmental concerns, cost estimating, and industry standards.
  • Ability to manage multiple stakeholders within the organization and business units.
  • Time management skills.
  • Active listening skills.
  • Critical thinking skills.
  • Problem solving skills.
  • Oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to motivate, develop, and direct people.
  • Ability to work independently, as well as in a team environment.
  • The ability to work in a constant state of alertness and safe manner.
  • Ability to successfully work from remote location.
  • Ability to meet the physical demands of the job.
  • Must have a cell phone and supply your own internet service.

Work Environment:

While performing the onsite/field duties, the employee is required to:

  • Walk (material part of an 8-hour workday, up to 3 to 4 continuous hours at one time.)
  • Stand (material part of an 8-hour workday, up to 3 to 4 continuous hours at one time.)
  • Climb and balance Stairs (at least once for each building assessed)
  • Repetitive use of hands/fingers for keyboard interaction (frequently)
  • Reach with hands and arms
  • Talk and hear (communicate with onsite contact)
  • Vision (close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus)
  • Operate an electronic tablet in the field for live data collection.
  • Operate a computer (up to 100% of workweek)
  • Operating a motor vehicle
  • Required to travel by Plane, Motor Vehicle, Train (up to 30% of the time) to client sites across the U.S. Overnight stays away from home may be required.

While performing the office/offsite duties of this job:

  • The employee is regularly required to use hands.
  • The employee is frequently required to stand, walk, sit, talk and hear.
  • The employee is occasionally required to reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
  • The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • The noise level in the home or company office environment is usually quiet.
