raw.description:
About Moniepoint

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in annual digital payment transaction value.

About The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Relations Partner to join the Corporate Affairs and R&D teams. You will work closely with our engineering teams to tell the story of what we’re building in a language that other expert engineers understand.

This is a technical content execution role requiring strong, foundational engineering skills. You will translate what our engineers build and learn into high-quality narratives: the kind that earns genuine respect in engineering communities, gets accepted at top-tier conferences, and attracts exceptional engineers from around the world.

The right person for this role is a skilled engineer who has found their voice as a writer and communicator; someone who can walk into a room of engineers as a peer, ask the right questions, and come out with a story worth telling.

Who You Are

To succeed in this role, you must have:

  • Strong engineering capabilities: A solid background in computer science or software engineering. You have written and shipped code professionally, understand modern system architectures, and can deeply engage with complex technical concepts.
  • Technical depth: Experience working within fintech, infrastructure, distributed systems, or high-scale engineering environments where you can comfortably read codebases, interpret technical documentation, and grasp deep architecture choices.
  • Exceptional writing skills: Clarity, precision, and the ability to articulate intricate technical trade-offs and ideas accessibly without oversimplifying or watering them down.
  • Proactive narrative instinct: The ability to independently dive into engineering projects, spot the most compelling technical breakthroughs or lessons, and build content around them without needing explicit instruction.
  • Technical credibility: A genuine, firsthand understanding of what makes technical content credible, shareable, and respected by discerning engineering communities.
  • Autonomy: The ability to manage multiple projects, technical interviews, and deadlines independently in a fully remote environment.

It's a strong plus if you have:

  • Active engineering or open-source involvement: An active presence in developer spaces, an updated technical blog, open-source contributions, or a history of speaking at engineering conferences.
  • Developer Relations experience: Background in DevRel or managing technical communities, showing you know how to engage developers authentically at scale.
  • Track record in technical publishing: Experience drafting accepted conference abstracts/proposals (CFPs) for recognized industry events.
  • Multimodal content production: Experience writing technical video scripts, technical teardowns, or working alongside creative production teams.

What to expect in the hiring process

  • A preliminary phone call with the recruiter
  • A take-home assessment
  • Panel interview
  • Executive interview

raw.description:
What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

A little more about your role…

Nuclear power is a vital component of the UK’s clean energy mix—essential for achieving net zero and securing a resilient energy future. In support of the UK government’s vision for a revitalised nuclear industry, we are proud to be one of the leading engineering and environmental professional services consultancies driving progress across the UK nuclear sector.

We have a long-standing track record of delivering work on some of the UK’s most complex infrastructure projects, including major nuclear developments such as Hinkley Point C, Sizewell C, Sellafield, the Geological Disposal Facility, and more recently advising on Small Modular Reactor (SMR) programmes. As one of the largest environmental consultancies in the UK, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to these landmark nuclear projects and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. You’ll be encouraged to explore new ideas in a culture that values curiosity and diverse perspectives.

With the growth of the UK nuclear sector comes increased scrutiny and a more complex consenting environment. As an Associate Consultant in our Environmental Consents team in London, you’ll play a role in navigating this landscape—supporting nuclear projects through strategic planning, environmental advice, and technical studies.

You’ll contribute to some of the UK’s most significant and transformative nuclear infrastructure projects, delivering services such as planning applications, EIAs, permitting and compliance, feasibility studies, and support for DCO examinations and planning inquiries to name a few.

This is a post which is of strategic significance for our business and represents a challenging and exciting opportunity to identify, win and deliver multi-disciplinary inputs for nuclear projects. We need people with creative spirit, a dedicated approach and a solid grounding in environmental design, assessment and management at any stage of the development project lifecycle.

Join a great organisation

As a Principal/ Associate or Associate Director, you will collaborate with a diverse team of technical specialists and design professionals to manage environmental contributions across project designs and assessments. You will be instrumental in improving the environmental performance for a range of nuclear projects.

The role would suit an enthusiastic individual looking to influence, manage and deliver environmental elements of nuclear projects. You will have responsibility for managing projects including tasks relating to bidding, project team management, project delivery, and financial management.

  • Playing a key role in growing our nuclear sector offer, working with sector leads and client account managers to drive thought leadership and win new business.
  • Providing environmental advice and support to clients, project managers and colleagues.
  • Working with colleagues, environmental specialists, clients and engineering teams to promote sustainable design and environmental enhancement.
  • Leading large, multiple, and complex projects, overseeing our performance on technical, quality, commercial, and health and safety.
  • Build strong client relationships and identify opportunities to support project strategy, resourcing and delivery.
  • Undertaking activities to secure new work, including developing proposals for complex opportunities, delivering strategic level bids and framework opportunities, and undertaking business development opportunities.
  • Champion innovation through approaches such as Digital EIA, Technical Excellence and Future Ready.
  • Driving performance improvement and career advancement opportunities across team.
  • Promote an inclusive and positive team environment, acting as a trusted advisor and mentor.
  • Promoting an inclusive workplace, demonstrating an understanding of Health and Safety whilst living the values of our health, safety, and wellbeing culture.
  • Undertaking actions that contribute towards the success of the WSP business strategy, whilst being self-motivated towards goals relevant to the role, team, and your projects.

What we will be looking for you to demonstrate…

  • Relevant environmental or planning degree (or equivalent experience), with chartered status or actively working towards chartership.
  • Demonstrable experience in delivering Environmental Impact Assessments (EIA) for nuclear projects, including under a range of UK planning regimes such as the Town and Country Planning Act, EIADR and the Planning Act 2008. Awareness of the application of the Environmental Permitting Regulations (EPR) 2016 is beneficial.

As the primary advocate for the customer, the TPO works closely with UI/UX architects, developers, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality, value-driven product releases.

This role is responsible for guiding the product lifecycle from concept to launch and beyond, ensuring that user needs are met while maintaining technical integrity. As a key leader, the TPO is ultimately accountable for the product’s success and continuous alignment with both business and user expectations. Prior experience in healthcare or healthcare-focused software is considered an advantage.

Key Responsibilities

Product Ownership & Agile Leadership

  • Act as the primary contact for major system issues and product-related inquiries.
  • Gather and document requirements from clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Manage and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring readiness for development.
  • Lead Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, sprint reviews, and other team meetings.
  • Collaborat closely with developers and QA to ensure product quality, accurate implementation, and smooth releases.
  • Communicate the value of new features to internal teams and clients.
  • Oversee and mentor the Product Owner team, including goal-setting, project assignments, and performance evaluations.
  • Maintain internal tools such as developer PTO and assignment trackers.

Regulatory Compliance

Manual Testing Team Oversight

Clinical Services (MIPS) Oversight

  • Ensured regulatory compliance and managed escalations.

Job Title: ﻿Paid Search Associate (Remote)

About the Client: a performance marketing agency specializing in healthy, active, and lifestyle brands. The company helps businesses drive growth through data-driven marketing, audience insights, media strategy, creative content, and integrated digital solutions.

Overview: ﻿The Paid Search Associate is a hands-on execution and account health role supporting the Paid Search team. This position builds search campaigns quickly and accurately, keeps live accounts clean and on budget, and finds problems before they cost clients money. Unlike a pure QA role, the associate is expected to diagnose what is wrong and propose a specific fix, not just flag that something looks off. The associate works from documented processes, build templates, and briefs from senior team members. Recommended fixes are reviewed and approved by the Search Manager before changes that affect strategy, bidding, or budget allocation are made. This role is not responsible for leading client communication, setting campaign strategy, or owning client performance goals.

Responsibilities:

  • Build new Google Ads search and Performance Max campaigns from approved briefs and templates, including campaign settings, ad groups, keywords, match types, negatives, RSAs, assets, and location targeting
  • Use Google Ads Editor and bulk sheets to build and launch multi-location campaigns quickly (many of our clients operate dozens to hundreds of locations)
  • Platform focus is Google Ads exclusively
  • Apply naming conventions, UTMs, and conversion settings correctly on every build
  • Run scheduled audits of live accounts against a standard checklist: disapprovals, limited ads, broken URLs, missing assets, conversion tracking status, budget and bid strategy settings, and naming consistency
  • Review search term reports to identify irrelevant or wasted spend and propose negative keywords
  • Perform daily delivery checks using internal tools and directly in platform to spot anomalies such as sudden drops or spikes in spend, clicks, CPC, conversion volume, or conversion rate
  • Identify the likely cause of each anomaly (for example, a paused campaign, a tracking break, a policy issue, a budget cap, or an auction change) before escalating
  • For every issue identified, document what happened, the likely cause, the recommended fix, and the expected impact
  • Implement approved fixes and routine corrections (disapprovals, broken URLs, negatives, asset updates) within agreed guidelines
  • Escalate issues that affect strategy, bidding, or budget allocation to the Search Manager with a recommendation, not just a flag
  • Monitor campaign pacing to ensure budgets are spending appropriately relative to plan; flag under- or over-spend issues promptly
  • Verify landing pages, URLs, and destination functionality prior to and after launch
  • Issue Tracking & Communication
  • Clearly communicate errors, risks, and pacing concerns to senior team members
  • Track identified issues through resolution to ensure no gaps in execution
  • Build Performance Max and Demand Gen campaigns from approved briefs
  • Own recurring audits for an assigned set of accounts end to end
  • Implement a wider range of approved optimizations (bid strategy target adjustments, budget shifts within plan, ad copy testing) with less review
  • Help maintain and improve build templates, audit checklists, and anomaly thresholds
  • Support a higher volume of accounts once consistency and trust are established

Qualifications:

  • Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience building and managing campaigns in Google Ads
  • Proficiency with Google Ads Editor and bulk editing in spreadsheets
  • Working knowledge of keyword match types, negative keyword strategy, RSAs, assets, bid strategies, and location targeting
  • Understanding of conversion tracking, including Google Tag Manager, GA4, and offline conversion imports
  • Demonstrated ability to diagnose the cause of a performance change, not just notice it
  • Google Ads Search certification preferred
  • Strong attention to detail and comfort with process-driven, high-volume work
  • Ability to work quickly without sacrificing accuracy and to meet deadlines consistently
  • Clear written communication skills for internal coordination and issue write-ups
  • Familiarity with Google Sheets, Google Slides, and Microsoft Teams

Schedule: ﻿Monday – Friday; 9AM – 5PM Pacific Time Zone.

Setup: Remote

Why Join STAFFVIRTUAL?

  • Competitive compensation and benefits package
    • HMO Day 1
    • Allowances
    • Attendance bonus
    • Paid time offs
  • Company-provided work setup (laptop, monitor, accessories)
  • Training, career growth, and global exposure
  • A collaborative and supportive team culture

If you're a motivated, client-focused professional who's ready to grow with a company that values people and performance, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now and join our dynamic team at STAFFVIRTUAL!

raw.description:
Descartes Unites the People and Technology that Move the World

The need for efficient, secure, and agile supply chains and logistics operations has become ever more critical and complex. By combining innovative technology, powerful trade intelligence and the reach of our network, Descartes helps get goods, information, transportation assets, and people where they’re needed, when they’re needed.

We’re one of the most broadly deployed logistics and supply chain technology companies in the world. More than 26,000 customers around the globe use our cloud-based solutions to transform the way they move inventory and information to enhance productivity, better serve customers, thrive competitively, keep pace with evolving regulations, and respond to rapidly changing market conditions. Descartes is publicly traded (Nasdaq:DSGX, TSX:DSG) with headquarters in Waterloo, Ontario, Canada, and offices and partners around the world. With record financial performance for more than 16 years, we lead the industry in innovation investment. Every day, logistics service providers, manufacturers, retailers, distributors, and other logistics-intensive businesses of all sizes rely on our scale, stability, and comprehensive solution footprint to move what’s most important to them. Learn more at www.descartes.com.

We’re growing fast and invite you to join our amazing team.

We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager to own a core product area within the Warehouse Management value stream of our eCommerce portfolio. Our WMS serves third-party logistics providers, brands, and retailers whose operations depend on our software every hour of every day, receiving, inventory, picking, packing, shipping, and billing, often for many clients inside a single warehouse. This is a senior individual contributor role with high expectations. You’ll own outcomes, not a backlog: deciding which problems are worth solving, validating them directly with customers, and driving delivery with Engineering through to measurable business results. The WMS business was recently acquired by Descartes, so you’ll also help shape how it connects to the rest of our portfolio; order and inventory management, shipping, and transportation.

What You’ll Do

Own Your Product Area and Its Outcomes

  • Define and communicate a focused strategy and roadmap for your product area, tied to clear business objectives and customer outcomes.
  • Be accountable for results of adoption, retention, revenue, and operational efficiency does not feature shipped.
  • Know your numbers: revenue, growth, usage, churn drivers, and where the product wins and loses against competitors.
  • Prioritize with discipline and be clear about what we will not build, and why.

Lead Discovery

  • Spend real time with customers; on calls and on warehouse floors to understand the problems behind the requests.
  • Validate problems before committing to solutions, using interviews, usage data, prototypes, and experiments.
  • Turn ambiguous, messy problems into structured, actionable plans.

Drive Execution with Engineering

  • Partner closely with Engineering to deliver complete solutions workflows, edge cases, integrations, and performance at scale.
  • Go deep enough technically to understand the architecture, APIs, and data model, and make sound tradeoffs with engineers.
  • Balance roadmap work, technical investment, and customer commitments; remove blockers and keep scope disciplined.

Build with AI

  • Use AI tools daily to move faster in discovery, analysis, specs, and prototyping.
  • Identify and deliver AI-driven capabilities that create real value for warehouse operators and know where AI doesn’t belong.

Shape the Commercial Side

  • Contribute to pricing, packaging, positioning, and upsell decisions, grounded in customer value and financial impact.
  • Build the business case for investments using market insight, customer evidence, and financial models.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Professional Services on launches, enablement, and competitive positioning.
  • Stay ahead of the market – competitors, customer expectations, and emerging technology in fulfillment and logistics.

Connect the Portfolio and Lead Without Authority

  • Work with Product Managers across Descartes to identify integration and partnership opportunities so our products work as a connected suite.
  • Help bring the acquired WMS business into Descartes’ operating model without losing what made it successful.
  • Earn trust with executives and cross-functional partners through clear communication, sound judgment, and data.
  • Mentor other PMs and help raise the bar for product practice across the team.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, owning products through discovery, delivery, and iteration.
  • Experience in warehouse management, fulfillment, 3PL, order management, inventory, shipping, or logistics software strongly preferred.
  • A track record of delivering business outcomes, not just features – and you can describe them in numbers.
  • High agency: you take initiative, create momentum, and own outcomes end to end without waiting to be asked.
  • Strong, hands-on discovery skills with direct customer exposure.
  • Technically fluent and comfortable in complex, multi-system, integration-heavy environments; a technical background is a plus.
  • Commercially fluent – you understand pricing, packaging, unit economics, and how your product makes money.
  • A daily, hands-on user of AI tools, with a point of view on how AI should shape both the product and the way product teams work.
  • Clear, concise communicator who brings structure to ambiguity and adapts to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Early signs of leadership – mentoring others, leading cross-functional initiatives, or influencing decisions above your level.
  • Willing to travel periodically to customer sites, warehouses, and team locations.

What We Value

  • Intellectual Curiosity: You don’t just accept the problem; you unpack it. You ask the second and third questions. You seek to understand, then act.
  • Bias for Ownership: You step into gaps, drive clarity, and take accountability for the result; not just the process.
  • Customer Empathy: You treat the customer’s problem like your own. You test assumptions and listen with the intent to solve.
  • Product Rigor: You know the difference between a roadmap and a strategy. You demand high-quality thinking and bring data to decisions.
  • Team-First: You make the people around you better. You share credit, own misses, and help others raise their game.

Why Join Us

This role offers real ownership of a product area at the core of physical warehouse operations at a moment when the portfolio is being shaped rather than maintained. Your work will be highly visible to leadership, and your ability to deliver outcomes will directly influence the growth of the business.
Location: This is a remote opportunity open to individuals who are legally entitled to work in Canada or the United States (with 10–20% travel across North America)..
Salary Range: $120,000 - $150,000 USD annually. Compensation information provided is a good faith estimate for this position only. Factors that may be used to determine your actual salary may include your specific skills as well as the years of experience you have. Similar positions located in different geographic regions will not necessarily receive the same compensation.

Join Us

As we scale, we’re looking for new doers, collaborators and innovators to join Descartes in uniting the people and technology that move the world as the Global Leader in Logistics and Supply Chain Technology. We’re entrepreneurial, hardworking, geeky-in-a-good way problem solvers. Guided by our values, we nurture a TEAM focused culture that invests in people and creates opportunities for advancement across a broad spectrum of career paths. We prioritize work-life balance and foster an environment with the space to take ownership, to be heard, and to carve a path for your individual accomplishments to help drive our success.

Descartes also has a deep sense of environmental responsibility. Learn more about how we helped our customers save over 552,000 metric tons of CO2 in 2020 by reducing fuel and paper consumption: .  Join a team that’s committed to working with customers to conserve resources and enhance sustainability.

At Descartes, everyone has a voice and the best idea wins, regardless of who makes it. We offer competitive compensation, great benefits, remote and flexible work hours, and the opportunity to join a company on an awesome mission with a great existing team and trajectory. If you feel you have 70% of the qualifications we are looking for, and Descartes sounds like the team and the mission you want to be part of, apply now. We can't promise it will be a fit, but we do promise to consider your experience.

raw.description:
Join the ACI Learning Adventure!

Our Mission

Welcome to a new era of learning, where individuals and organizations come to transform goals into measurable success. At ACI Learning, we believe that anything worth doing is worth leading the way—with innovation, exceptional experiences, and impactful results.

We provide a full ecosystem of learning and development solutions that empower people and businesses to lead with confidence, learn with purpose, and achieve outcomes that matter. Join us, and together, we'll shape the future of skill-building and professional growth.

The ACI Team

Imagine collaborating with over 200 of the brightest minds who are passionate, grounded, and dedicated to shaping the future of eLearning. Together, we're not just a team; we're a movement in one of the most exciting times in tech.

Purpose-Driven Culture

At ACI Learning, work isn’t just a job. It’s a passion we pour into every project, every day. We celebrate creativity, innovation, and the joy of doing what we love.

Your Opportunity

Are you ready to be part of something transformative? Dive into a world of collaboration, growth, and endless potential. Apply now and help lead the change!

Who We Are

ACI Learning is a leading provider of audit, cybersecurity and IT training solutions, empowering individuals and organizations worldwide to improve their technical capabilities and their cybersecurity with compelling and comprehensive training. Our leadership position extends even further to our new SaaS Learning Platform myACI that goes beyond audit, cyber and IT training to provide organizational and individual knowledge assessment, analytics and training delivery with integrated AI to understand capabilities and skill gaps for organizations.

The Role

This is a broad, independently-run People Operations seat with real ownership over how it works, not a narrow lane where someone else makes the calls. Talent acquisition is the biggest focus (~60%), with payroll (~10%) and performance management, employee relations, advisory, and systems administration rounding out the rest (~30%).

This role is built as a first step, not a ceiling. There's real room to grow, whether that's building out a team, expanding scope, taking on compensation management for candidates who bring that background, or stepping into a more senior seat down the line. It's an especially strong move if you're already operating above your current title and ready for the autonomy and official scope to match, or if you're a talent acquisition professional looking to expand into the rest of People Operations.

One requirement we won't bend on: AI has to be part of how you work, not a tool you've heard of. If you haven't used AI to speed up sourcing, screening, payroll, or HR documentation, this isn't the seat.

What You'll Own

Talent Acquisition (~60%)

  • Full-cycle recruiting ownership for all open requisitions: sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offers, and candidate communication
  • Direct accountability for time to fill and requisition throughput across the org
  • Proactive, consistent hiring manager support, including setting and managing expectations when volume or market conditions create friction
  • Building a recruiting process and funnel that holds up under increasing volume without needing headcount added every time things get busy
  • Using AI tools to speed up sourcing, screening, and candidate communication without sacrificing candidate experience

Payroll (~10%)

  • Biweekly payroll processing and administration, run efficiently and accurately
  • Expected to use AI tools to streamline payroll execution, not process it the slow, manual way
  • Coordination with Finance on payroll-adjacent compliance (tax withholding, multi-state SUI, income withholding orders) as needed

Performance Management, Employee Relations, Advisory & Systems Administration (~30%)

  • Supporting performance management processes and documentation across the organization
  • Employee relations casework, with appropriate judgment on when to escalate versus resolve independently
  • Serving as a People Ops advisor to managers and directors org-wide, including those outside your reporting line
  • Acting as one of our primary admins for the People Ops systems environment, including the HRIS, ATS, and other related platforms: configuration, workflow setup, permissions, data integrity, and ongoing maintenance
  • Keeping those systems configured to match our actual needs as they evolve, rather than letting configuration drift from how the business actually works
  • Identifying where current People Ops processes won't hold up as the company scales, and building the fix before it's a crisis

Backup Support & Cross-Training

Beyond the three focus areas above, you'll also cross-train across other parts of the People Operations function so you can provide backup support where needed, including:

  • Onboarding and offboarding
  • Promotions
  • Records management
  • Other People Operations processes as they come up

This isn't a stretch ask on top of an already full plate, it's intentional. Over time, the expectation is that you grow into full ownership and management of HR and people-related processes across the function, operating in close alignment with the strategic direction and oversight the VP of People Operations provides. Someone who takes this on well has a real path toward a Director-level role down the line.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5-8 years of experience in People Operations/HR, including direct, hands-on ownership of a Talent Acquisition function, not just support or coordination within one
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources, or a directly related field, or equivalent additional directly related work experience in lieu of a degree
  • Demonstrated use of AI tools in actual recruiting or HR workflows; be ready to talk specifics, not just familiarity
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills; you treat recruiting like a process to be measured and improved, not a queue to be worked
  • A track record of moving requisitions quickly and keeping time-to-fill down, ideally with numbers to back it up
  • Comfortable operating independently across multiple functions with minimal oversight
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to advise managers and directors outside your reporting line with credibility

Preferred Qualifications

  • SHRM-CP/SHRM-SCP or PHR/SPHR (HRCI) credential; very strong preference, though not an automatic disqualifier for an otherwise exceptional candidate
  • Hands-on administration experience with an ATS (Greenhouse or similar) and/or an HRIS (HiBob or similar), beyond end-user familiarity; comfortable owning configuration and system upkeep, not just using what's already set up
  • Payroll processing experience, ADP or comparable platform; willingness and aptitude to take it on and run it efficiently with AI assistance matters more than prior tenure
  • Experience with employee relations casework and performance management process design
  • Experience building or significantly improving a recruiting function's process or systems from scratch, rather than operating inside one that was already built
  • Background in a lean or rapidly scaling organization where you've had to build structure without a large team behind you
  • Compensation management experience (benchmarking, pay bands, equity); not expected on day one, but a strong bonus and a natural area for this role to grow into for the right candidate

This description covers the major, most essential areas of responsibility for this role. It isn't an exhaustive list of every task, and as both you and the function grow, expect the scope of what you own to grow right along with it.

At ACI Learning, we offer a competitive, experience-driven salary range that aligns with your qualifications and contributions. To that end, the posted salary range reflects our most reasonable assumption of pay for this position at the time of posting.

Pay range
$90,000—$110,000 USD

Why ACI Learning is Your Next Big Move

For Full-Time, Benefits Eligible Positions

Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage—starting the 1st of the month after your hire date.

Four weeks of paid parental or medical leave, so you can focus on what matters most.

Flexible PTO policy, sick time, and eight paid holidays — because we believe in balance.

401(k) retirement plan so you can invest in your future from day one.

One free course each year after 90 days — advancing your skills is part of the job.

Tuition assistance to support your continued education and professional growth.

About the RoleAs an Enterprise Account Executive at CharterUP, you’ll play a key role in building and scaling our enterprise business. You’ll own the full sales cycle—from identifying and pursuing high-value opportunities to building relationships with senior decision-makers and closing deals across high-growth verticals like construction, traditional shuttle, and events.

This is a high-impact role for a strategic, driven seller who thrives in a fast-moving startup environment. You’ll have the autonomy to open new doors, shape our enterprise sales strategy, and close deals that directly contribute to CharterUP’s growth—all while helping some of the world’s leading companies rethink how they move their people.

With a focus on targeting large organizations that book recurring trips for 30 days or more, your success will directly impact CharterUP’s ambitious growth targets, driving revenue within the enterprise shuttle vertical. If you’re looking to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with a focus on team collaboration and customer-centric solutions, this is the role for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Prospecting & New Business Development: Source and build relationships with key decision makers in target verticals, positioning CharterUP as the trusted provider for Enterprise group transportation services
  • Sales Strategy & Execution:Design and implement strategic outbound sales motions tailored to enterprise-level clients across key sectors. Ensure seamless navigation through procurement processes to secure approved vendor status while working closely with the VP of Enterprise Sales to align on growth initiatives and maximize new business opportunities.
  • Manage the Sales Cycle: Own the full sales cycle from lead generation to closing, navigating complex procurement processes, including RFP submissions, and securing long-term contracts with key clients.
  • Account Management: Manage complex sales cycles by proactively pursuing and securing MSAs with large entities that have significant annual spend. Navigate RFP submissions and MSA negotiations to ensure high success rates and alignment with organizational goals.
  • Collaboration & Support: Work closely with the account management and operations teams to ensure smooth handoffs and deliver exceptional service to new clients post-sale.
  • Account Expansion: Proactively grow revenue within your portfolio by cross-selling additional services and identifying opportunities for increasing wallet share.
  • Relationship Building: Establish and nurture strong relationships with key decision-makers across multiple organizational levels, driving consistent adoption of our platform.
  • Technology Expertise: Master our cutting-edge platform to demonstrate its capabilities to prospects, positioning CharterUP as an innovative, scalable solution for their transportation needs.
  • Market Research: Stay informed about the latest trends and market shifts within target industries, providing valuable insights to help shape CharterUP’s offerings.

What You’ll Bring

  • Proven Sales Experience: 5+ years of proven experience in enterprise sales, preferably within transportation, construction, engineering, procurement or related industries.
  • Track Record of Success: Proven ability to manage long sales cycles and close deals with a value of $1M+ in annual revenue.Demonstrated success in exceeding sales targets and achieving recognition as a top performer.
  • Complex Sales Cycles: Experience in navigating enterprise sales processes, including RFP’s, multi-year agreements, and negotiating MSAs with Fortune 500 organizations.
  • Relationship Building: Strong skills in building rapport with senior managers and executives within target organizations, ensuring long-term relationships and successful account management.
  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to think strategically about prospecting, sales motions, and account management to ensure alignment with company goals.
  • Self-Starter & Entrepreneurial: Highly motivated with the ability to work independently, manage your time effectively, and take ownership of your sales targets.

Global Benefits & Perks at CharterUP

We believe great people can live anywhere—and they deserve great benefits, too. While offerings may vary slightly by location, we prioritize hiring near our hubs in Austin, Atlanta, Miami, and Denver as we grow our global team.

  • Flexible Work Model: CharterUP operates as a remote-first company, with select roles requiring regular, in-office presence based on team and business needs. Role-specific expectations will be shared during the hiring process. U.S.-based employees may reside in any of our 19 approved states.
  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, mental health support, virtual care, gym discounts, and family-building benefits. In the U.S., we cover 100% of premiums for employees. International benefits align with local standards.
  • Time Off to Recharge: Paid time off so you can truly unplug. U.S.: 15 PTO days (increasing to 20 after 2 years) + 8 paid holidays. International policies vary by country.

  • Planning for the Future: Long-term financial planning support. U.S.: 401(k) plan. International: region-specific savings programs where applicable.
  • Top-Tier Tech: Choose a Mac or PC, plus monitor, keyboard, and mouse to hit the ground running.

Cybersecurity Engineer – Remote

DAS Health – Healthcare IT Managed Services & Solutions

Overview
DAS Health is seeking a Cybersecurity Engineer to join our growing cybersecurity team. This role plays a critical part in protecting client and organizational data, with a strong focus on safeguarding patient health information (PHI) in a healthcare environment.
The Cybersecurity Engineer will design, implement, and manage security controls across complex healthcare IT systems while ensuring compliance with key regulatory frameworks such as HIPAA, HITECH, and SOC 2. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced MSP environment and is passionate about security, compliance, and protecting critical healthcare systems.
Key Responsibilities
  • Design and implement security architecture across healthcare systems, including EHR platforms, medical devices, and healthcare information exchanges
  • Configure and manage security tools such as firewalls, IDS/IPS, SIEM, DLP, MFA, EDR, and encryption technologies
  • Conduct vulnerability assessments and penetration testing, identifying and mitigating risks across client environments
  • Monitor and respond to security incidents, performing root cause analysis and implementing corrective actions
  • Develop and maintain incident response plans, ensuring rapid and compliant response to security breaches
  • Perform forensic analysis and support breach investigations, including HIPAA reporting requirements
  • Monitor security systems and logs, proactively identifying threats and unusual activity
  • Build and maintain reporting dashboards for clients and internal stakeholders
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards, including HIPAA, HITECH, HITRUST, and SOC 2 Type II
  • Support audit readiness and participation, including documentation and control maintenance
  • Collaborate with internal teams and clients to integrate security into daily workflows and operations
  • Support security awareness training and partner with vendors to ensure strong security practices
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field (Master’s or certifications preferred)
  • 3–5 years of cybersecurity engineering experience, ideally within a healthcare or MSP environment
  • Hands-on experience with security technologies including firewalls, IDS/IPS, SIEM, DLP, MFA, EDR, and email security
  • Experience securing cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Experience supporting or preparing for SOC 2 Type II audits
  • Strong knowledge of healthcare compliance frameworks (HIPAA, HITECH, HITRUST)
  • Familiarity with network and security architecture in complex environments
  • Experience with scripting tools such as Python or PowerShell
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage complex security challenges
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • High level of professionalism, attention to detail, and integrity
Why DAS Health?
At DAS Health, we’re helping healthcare organizations operate more efficiently and securely through innovative technology solutions. When you join our team, you’ll benefit from:
  • Competitive compensation and benefits
  • Career growth opportunities within a fast-growing organization
  • Exposure to diverse client environments and technologies
  • A collaborative, team-oriented culture
  • The opportunity to make a meaningful impact in healthcare

DAS Health is a leading healthcare IT managed services provider and technology partner. We support healthcare organizations with managed IT services, cybersecurity, and consulting solutions that improve operational efficiency, enhance patient experiences, and drive better outcomes

Role Title: Brand & Creative Strategy Expert — Executive Presentation Review

Role Type: Contract

Location: Remote

In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This specialized engagement involves reviewing business slides from sales, revenue, or go-to-market contexts, reconstructing them in PowerPoint, and critically evaluating both your improvements and your decision-making process. Those who can defend both the changes made and the elements left untouched will thrive in this role. Flexibility and deep subject-matter expertise are highly valued.

Required Skills:

  • Microsoft PowerPoint

  • Slide Reconstruction

  • Presentation Design

  • Data Visualization

  • Visual Storytelling

  • Content Editing

  • Critical Thinking

  • Attention to Detail

  • Written Communication

  • Sales

  • GTM

  • Consulting

Scope of Work:

  • Receive images of existing business slides from sales, revenue, or GTM presentations for executive audiences.

  • Rebuild provided slides in Microsoft PowerPoint, ensuring accuracy and improvement of visual storytelling, hierarchy, and data visualization.

  • Edit and enhance slide content while preserving or elevating clarity, messaging, and executive-ready aesthetics.

  • Write a comprehensive reasoning log for each task, detailing every change made and every element left unchanged, with explicit rationale for both.

  • Assess slide effectiveness based on message hierarchy, action titles, exhibit choice, and audience relevance.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Proficient in Microsoft PowerPoint, data visualization, content editing, and visual storytelling techniques.

  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to articulate and defend design, content, and messaging decisions.

  • Attention to detail and robust critical thinking applied to every presentation review and reconstruction.

  • Industry operators as well as consultants are encouraged — deep domain expertise is prioritized over consulting pedigree.

  • Experience with AI training, evaluation, or rubric-writing is a plus, but not required.

raw.description:
Order.co is the System of Action for the Office of the CFO, transforming the way businesses purchase and pay into an intuitive, B2C-like shopping experience. Order.co leverages embedded AI agents and embedded financial products to reinvent the way businesses connect with their vendors.

End users enjoy a seamless, zero-training buying experience, while finance and procurement leaders gain a single platform to orchestrate how the business “should operate”. The result is an all-in-one solution that serves as a gravitational pull for spend and data, automating and eliminating procurement and finance workflows from requisition to reconciliation along the way.

Order.co is on the cutting edge of B2B Agentic Commerce, poised to be the market leader in creating a more predictive, prescriptive, and personalized experience for users.

Founded in 2016 and headquartered in New York City, Order.co oversees nearly half a billion in annualized spend across hundreds of customers like WeWork, SoulCycle, Lume, and [solidcore]. Order.co has raised $75M in funding from industry-leading investors like MIT, Stage 2 Capital, Rally Ventures, 645 Ventures, and more. Order.co has been proudly named a 50 to Watch by Spend Matters and a Best Place to Work by BuiltIn and Inc. Magazine.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer specializing in Design Systems to scale and evolve our design system across the Order.co platform and explore how AI can improve design-to-development workflows.

You’ll partner closely with Product Design, Engineering, and Product Management to modernize legacy experiences, develop reusable patterns, and make the system easier to discover, adopt, and contribute to. This role is ideal for a systems-minded designer who combines strong strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

What You’ll Do

  • Scale and evolve the design system, with a focus on high-traffic legacy experiences.
  • Audit existing experiences to identify component gaps, inconsistencies, and opportunities for consolidation.
  • Partner with engineers to create scalable, accessible, and production-ready components.
  • Champion usability, accessibility, consistency, and quality across the product.
  • Establish and communicate design system principles and decisions across the organization.
  • Explore AI-enabled workflows for component discovery, documentation, quality checks, and pattern generation.
  • Reduce duplication and improve efficiency across design and engineering.
  • Measure and improve system adoption, usability, and effectiveness.

What We’re Looking For

  • 4–7 years of product design experience, including significant design system experience.
  • Proven experience building, scaling, or evolving a design system.
  • Strong expertise in component-based design and reusable interaction patterns.
  • Advanced Figma skills and familiarity with modern design system workflows.
  • Strong understanding of how design systems translate into production code.
  • Experience partnering closely with engineers and navigating tradeoffs between flexibility, consistency, and scalability.
  • Hands-on experience with AI tools and curiosity about their application to design systems.
  • Excellent visual, interaction, communication, and systems-thinking skills.
  • Curiosity about AI and its impact on product design and design systems, with hands-on experience using AI tools
  • A portfolio demonstrating meaningful design system work.
  • Fintech and/or ecommerce experience is a plus.

Contract-to-Hire

This role begins as a 6-month contract, with the intention to convert to full-time based on mutual fit and business needs. You’ll have the opportunity to shape the foundation of our product experience and become a key partner to the Product Design and Engineering teams.

Rate: $95/hr

raw.description:
We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!

About the role

Grüns is one of the fastest-growing consumer brands in the country, now part of Unilever's Wellbeing Collective, and we're hiring our second lawyer. You'll work directly with — and be mentored by—our General Counsel, a former Morrison & Foerster partner with more than a decade in consumer products, work alongside the principals and operators who built the company and are taking it to the next level, and you'll see more legal terrain in a year than many lawyers see in their entire careers: national retailer deals, creator and sponsorship agreements, litigation, advertising enforcement, brand protection, sweepstakes, privacy, IP, and whatever tomorrow brings. This role owns the day-to-day legal work that keeps the business moving — contracts, litigation management, and advertising enforcement. You'll negotiate directly with counterparties, sit with Marketing, Retail, Ops, People, and Customer Experience while decisions get made, and build the systems a fast-moving legal function needs (and improve the ones that already exist). This seat is built to grow with the person in it. And you won't be doing it alone: alongside the Grüns seat you'll have a working relationship with Unilever's commercial contracting, litigation, IP, privacy, and employment teams and the chance to partner with Unilever Wellbeing Legal — the ownership and pace of a company that's still building, with the depth and network of one of the world's largest consumer companies within reach.

This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL.

Why this role:

  • Breadth you can't get in most legal roles: contracts, litigation, IP, marketing, privacy, and employment in one seat, with real ownership of each
  • Mentorship from a General Counsel who built this function from scratch and wants you to grow into more
  • The best of both worlds: the pace, ownership, and direct access to business leaders of a company that's still building, with Unilever's platform, specialist depth, and global legal network behind it
  • Authority from day one: you own your matters and negotiate directly with counterparties
  • A bigger legal team than our headcount suggests: Unilever colleagues in commercial contracting, litigation, IP, privacy, and employment, plus Unilever Wellbeing Legal, to learn from, partner with, and call on
  • Evaluated on impact, not hours: no billable hours and no timesheets — you're measured on your judgment, efficiency, productivity, and the value you add to the business

This is not a typical legal job, and it isn't for everyone. It's for a lawyer who is thirsting for more—more responsibility, more range, more direct impact—earlier than most legal careers will offer it. If that's you, we'd like to meet you.

In this role, you will:

  • Own commercial contract review end to end: intake, first-turn redlines, negotiation with counterparties, practical advice to the business team, and execution across vendor, marketing and creator partnership, agency, and retailer agreements — partnering with Unilever's commercial contracting team on agreements that run through Unilever's templates and approval processes
  • Run litigation management: litigation holds and preservation, discovery and subpoena coordination with outside counsel and Unilever's global litigation team, a live matter and budget tracker, and regular reporting to the General Counsel and, on contentious matters, to Unilever Litigation
  • Lead advertising enforcement and brand protection: draft cease-and-desist and demand letters when competitors' advertising is false or misleading, track responses, recommend when a filing or challenge is warranted, and support trademark and anti-counterfeiting efforts
  • Build the systems that make Legal faster and smarter: a precedent and template library, negotiation playbooks with fallback positions and approval matrices, a contract repository with key terms tagged, matter and budget tracking, and guidelines for how the legal function uses AI
  • Handle recurring marketing and promotions work — customizing sweepstakes and giveaway rules, standard consent and opt-in language, releases — within the framework the General Counsel and Regulatory set
  • Coordinate with Unilever's legal teams: work with Unilever's specialist teams (IP, privacy, employment, litigation) and Unilever Wellbeing legal team when a matter requires their review or can benefit from their support, and help build shared ways of working between the Grüns and Unilever Wellbeing legal teams
  • Own legal operations: run intake and prioritization so the business always knows where its requests stand, and manage outside counsel budgets and invoice

We're looking for someone who:

  • Holds a JD and an active bar license in good standing in at least one US jurisdiction, and—if they live in a state where they aren't admitted — is eligible to register there as in-house counsel
    Has roughly 3-4 years of post-JD experience—at a firm, in-house, at a fund, in government, or somewhere less traditional—and has negotiated commercial contracts start to finish across vendor, SaaS, marketing, and/or retailer agreements.
  • Exercises judgment on risk in fast-moving, high-stakes situations, and has been handed a problem outside their core area and figured it out rather than waiting to be told how
  • Ideally has some litigation exposure: has drafted or managed a hold, handled discovery or subpoena logistics, or run point with outside counsel on a matter (a plus, not required)
  • Has demonstrated entrepreneurial energy— through an operating or sales role, a business degree or MBA, a startup or a family business, or something else outside the straight line from school to practice (a plus, not required)
  • Innovates, including through fluent and thoughtful AI use, with a deep understanding of how to verify what it produces every time, and a proactive approach to protecting confidential and privileged information in a rapidly changing environment
  • Has experience in CPG, DTC, supplements, food and beverage, or advertising law (strongly preferred)

Approach to the role:

  • Exceptionally organized: every open matter has an owner, a next step, and a status the requester can check without having to ask; this is a requirement, not a preference — you'll carry dozens of matters at once
  • Takes initiative: sees what needs doing and starts; brings the General Counsel a proposed answer alongside the question when escalating; and is excited to build the templates, systems, and skills that make the function better over time
  • Comfortable being handed something unfamiliar: reads the statute, asks the right person, uses the right tools for education and a first pass, and gets to an informed answer
  • Calibrates effort to the deal, the counterparty, and the negotiating dynamics; knows a small sponsorship doesn't need the same treatment as a major supply agreement, and aims for the best result for the business under the circumstances
  • Understands margin, subscription economics, and what the team is actually trying to accomplish, and can translate that into a clear recommendation

Compensation & Benefits:

At Grüns, we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary range is $150,000-$185,000 plus bonus depending on experience, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team.

A bit about us...

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

What we care about...

Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

Compensation & Perks:

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

raw.description:
Chooose builds software to enable the lower carbon fuel value chain.

Companies like Delta Air Lines, Cathay Pacific, British Airways, and Microsoft use the Chooose platform to build, operate, and scale their lower carbon fuel programs (typically referred to as Sustainable Aviation Fuel, or SAF), and to advance voluntary and compliance carbon management initiatives.

With offices in Miami and Oslo, and remote employees across the US and Europe, Chooose is relentlessly focused on delivering enterprise software products to enable our customers to drive lower carbon fuel adoption. The company has raised $50M from leading venture capital and strategic investors.

The role

As a Engagement Manager at Chooose, you will partner with our enterprise customers in the aviation and energy sectors, enabling them to build and operate their SAF programs. In close collaboration with the Chooose Customer organization, you will own day-to-day relationships with our largest customers in your assigned region, supporting customers across their entire experience with the Chooose platform, from implementation to solution go-live and beyond.
This is a remote role that must be based in Illinois, Texas, Massachusetts, New York, Pennsylvania, Maryland, or Florida
Alt ID: Strategic Account Manager / Client Partner / Engagement Manager / Enterprise CSM / Strategic Account Lead

What you'll do

  • Own total responsibility for a portfolio of key enterprise customers within the aviation, energy, and logistics sectors.
  • Become the expert on the customer's SAF program. Thoroughly understand the customer’s program objectives, and guide how the customer leverages the Chooose platform to reach these objectives.
  • Cultivate high-trust relationships with key stakeholders across our customer organizations (from Sustainability to Fuel Procurement) and function as the customer's trusted advisor.
  • Drive customer success. Assess, clarify, and validate customer needs and new commercial expansion opportunities on an ongoing basis. Proactively qualify and champion these needs and opportunities internally, with an emphasis on gathering and delivering structured product feedback.
  • Maintain a balanced approach and multiple perspectives. Enable commercial growth while considering Chooose's commitment to enabling long-term, high-integrity climate action.
  • Manage complex software deployments. Supported by an assigned Technical Implementation Manager and other key resources, oversee the implementation of complex decarbonization programs including a range of climate solutions from Sustainable Aviation Fuel to carbon offsets and removals.
  • Refine our playbook. Drive continuous improvement across Technical Implementation, Customer Operations, and Customer Success functions.
  • Collaborate with multiple Chooose teams to execute the operational tasks needed to achieve program objectives on time and with high quality.
  • Proactively and continually educate yourself on the carbon-related requirements and market trends impacting our customers and the sectors in which we operate.

What you bring to the table

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree from an accredited institution, ideally in the hard sciences.
  • Minimum of 4 years of demonstrated success in management consulting, SaaS implementation, enterprise project management, or similar.
  • Experience in enterprise software organizations relating to carbon markets, fuel markets, or carbon accounting is a plus.
  • Technical capability. You enjoy helping customers solve business and technical problems, and are comfortable with technical and highly configurable SaaS solutions. Previous experience with API integrations and enterprise-grade SaaS solutions is a plus.
  • You listen carefully and authentically care about solving customer problems.
  • Polished presentation skills and are comfortable discussing technical and commercial topics with external stakeholders.
  • Self-directed problem solver who takes initiative
  • Flexible with work hours for global customer support.
  • You're willing to be flexible with your work hours to support your colleagues and accommodate our global customers.
  • You’re open to frequent travel on short notice.
  • You have superior verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Spanish is a plus.
  • Must be based in Illinois, Texas, Massachusetts, New York, Pennsylvania, Maryland, or Florida

The interview process

At Chooose, we prioritize transparency throughout our interview process. If your qualifications look like a fit, we’ll begin with a few introductory conversations where you'll have the chance to discuss your experience and learn more about our company. The second phase varies depending on the role and will involve a practical exercise for you to show your work. You’ll receive written instructions for the exercise in advance, and we’ll then schedule a time to discuss. The third and final phase consists of a one-on-one conversation with a member of our executive team. The process should take approx. 4-6 weeks. While we strive to keep to this timeline, the occasional adjustment may occur; we’re focused on ensuring enough time to get to know one another.

Pay, perks, & more

We offer a competitive salary, a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance, voluntary 401k contributions, paid parental leave, a robust PTO package, the option to participate in our employee equity program, flexible work hours, and access to 'Spaces' coworking space.
We value diversity and believe forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We encourage people from underrepresented backgrounds and different industries to apply.
Compensation will be based on experience and skill, commensurate with market rates, and will include both salary and equity in Chooose.
Chooose is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion (creed), gender, gender expression, age, national origin (ancestry), disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or military status. We are committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming environment to our employees and welcome input from candidates and employees on how we can enhance our inclusiveness.
Prerequisite for Employment: Chooose may request to conduct background checks on prospective applicants to verify the information provided in the CV, transcripts, and other documentation. This background check may be carried out by our partner and will not be conducted without the applicant's prior consent. Prospective applicants will receive more information about this.

Don't see the perfect role open right now? Let's change that.

At Buynomics, we are growing fast. Sometimes, great talent doesn’t fit into a pre-defined box, or perhaps your dream job just hasn’t been posted yet. If you are passionate about pricing, simulation technology, and SaaS, but don’t see a specific opening that matches your background, we still want to hear from you.

Want to join Buynomics, but you are not sure which of the openings match your skillset best?

No worries – send us your application anyway, and we will help you find the most suitable position with us. We look forward to receiving your application!

raw.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

GitLab is building the most comprehensive AI-powered DevSecOps platform, and this role will help shape how teams move from planning to code in an AI-native software development lifecycle.

As Senior Product Manager, Plan to Code, you'll shape how planning and managing source code will evolve in an AI-native software development lifecycle. This role is focused on bringing planning and code closer together, so teams can move from requirements and specifications to commits, merge requests, and customer value with speed and quality.

This area is evolving quickly. We're exploring how AI agents can use specifications, context, and human feedback to build the right thing, not just build the thing right. You'll help define new product experiences that support spec-driven development, human-in-the-loop workflows, and a more seamless handoff from planning to coding.

This is an ambiguous, high-impact opportunity for a product manager who has strong software development lifecycle knowledge, is comfortable working with technical teams, and wants to help create something new in DevSecOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Define and drive product strategy for experiences that connect planning, source code management, and AI-assisted development.
  • Help shape spec-driven development workflows that make it easier for teams and AI agents to move from requirements to code.
  • Work with engineering, design, and other product teams to build product experiences that support human-in-the-loop and autonomous development workflows.
  • Partner with teams working on demos and prototypes, including near-term work around spec-driven planning and autonomous development modes.
  • Use customer insights, product usage data, and market context to identify opportunities that can deliver customer value quickly.
  • Help teams ship fast with quality, balancing near-term execution with longer-term product direction.
  • Explore how planning can better account for reviewing code, reviewing test cases, and validating that work produced by agents matches the intended outcome.
  • Collaborate across Plan, Source Code Management, Code Review, and AI product areas to reduce friction across the software development lifecycle.

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience as a product manager working on developer tools, DevOps tools, source code management, planning tools, AI-native products, or related software development lifecycle products.
  • Strong understanding of how software moves from ideas and requirements through planning, coding, review, testing, and delivery.
  • Experience working with technical product areas and engineering teams, with enough technical depth to understand developer workflows and tradeoffs.
  • A data-forward approach to product management, including experience using data to identify customer impact and guide prioritization.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguous spaces where there may not yet be a clear market pattern or established product category.
  • Experience using or building with AI tools, agents, or AI-assisted workflows in a way that goes beyond basic prompting.
  • Ability to think creatively about how AI changes the software development lifecycle and how product experiences should adapt.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, especially in an all-remote, asynchronous environment.
  • A bias toward action and the ability to help teams ship meaningful customer value quickly.

About the team

This role sits within the Product organization and will work closely with teams across Plan, Source Code Management, Code Review, and AI. We are focused on helping GitLab customers plan, build, and deliver software in a faster, more connected way.

You'll join a group that is rethinking how planning and coding should work as AI changes the speed and shape of software development. Rather than treating planning, coding, and review as separate stages, we're exploring how to bring these workflows closer together so humans and agents can collaborate more effectively.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. raw.description:
Chooose builds software to enable the lower carbon fuel value chain.

Companies like Delta Air Lines, Cathay Pacific, British Airways, and Microsoft use the Chooose platform to build, operate, and scale their lower carbon fuel programs (typically referred to as Sustainable Aviation Fuel, or SAF), and to advance voluntary and compliance carbon management initiatives.

With offices in Miami and Oslo, and remote employees across the US and Europe, Chooose is relentlessly focused on delivering enterprise software products to enable our customers to drive lower carbon fuel adoption. The company has raised $50M from leading venture capital and strategic investors.

This opportunity is exclusively available as a B2B arrangement

As a Product Owner at Chooose, you will own the end-to-end product vision, roadmap, and execution for your domain. You’ll work with a core team of engineers and designers to build products that enable the largest aviation fuel suppliers and fuel buyers to accelerate their lower carbon fuel business processes.

We’re looking for someone who is energized by ambiguity, deeply curious about the frontier of AI in enterprise products, and passionate about building products that balance technical depth with intuitive user experiences. You’ll need to be hands-on with prototyping and comfortable translating complex systems into clear, user-centered solutions.

This role reports to the CTO.

What you'll do

  • Own the vision, roadmap and execution for a Chooose domain, balancing intuition with data

  • Deeply understand the aviation fuel market and our customers’ needs by spending time with customers

  • Drive high-velocity execution with a distributed team of engineers and designers

  • Prototype rapidly using tools like Cursor to accelerate the product development lifecycle and fast-forward to production-ready products

  • Stay deeply plugged into AI tooling, industry trends, and emergent applications, filtering signal from noise and applying it accelerate execution for the Product team

  • Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization such as Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Sales, Account Management, and Operations

What you bring to the table

  • BA/BS in a technical or analytical field (e.g. Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Analytics, Mathematics, Physics, Applied Sciences, or related)

  • Minimum 4 years of product management or adjacent product-building experience in an enterprise context

  • Strong customer empathy and design thinking

  • Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping, or side projects, and staying current on tools

  • Fluency with core LLM concepts and systems, such as prompting, fine-tuning, embeddings, retrieval, and evaluation, and the judgment to translate these into reliable, user-facing products

  • Fluency with modern prototyping tools (e.g. Cursor, Claude Code) and comfort with design/collaboration environments (Figma)

  • Fluency in data and experimentation, and understanding when the answer cannot be found in the data

  • Proven ability to lead small, technical teams toward ambitious product goals with urgency

  • Ability to translate between technical and non-technical audiences, synthesizing complex systems into compelling narratives

  • Native-level English writing and speaking skills

Nice to have

  • Experience building in financial, enterprise, or other compliance-heavy domains requiring precision and complex systems thinking

  • Experience in high growth startups

  • Experience getting results on a distributed team

  • Polish language skills

Not for you if

  • You prefer product strategy briefings over hands-on delivery

  • You’re not building with AI

The interview process

At Chooose, we prioritize transparency throughout our interview process. If your qualifications look like a fit, we’ll begin with a few introductory conversations where you'll have the chance to discuss your experience and learn more about our company. The second phase varies depending on the role and will most likely involve a practical exercise to show your work. The third and final phase consists of a few one-on-one conversation members of the executive team. The process should take approx. 4-6 weeks. While we strive to keep to this timeline, the occasional adjustment may occur; we’re focused on ensuring for enough time to get to know one another.

We value diversity and believe forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We encourage people from underrepresented backgrounds and different industries to apply.

Compensation will be based on experience and skill, commensurate with market rates, and will include both a monthly fee and equity in Chooose.

Chooose is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion (creed), gender, gender expression, age, national origin (ancestry), disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or military status. We are committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming environment to our employees and welcome input from candidates and employees on how we can enhance our inclusiveness.

Prerequisite for Employment: Chooose may request to conduct background checks on prospective applicants to verify the information provided in the CV, transcripts, and other documentation. This background check may be carried out by our partner and will not be conducted without the applicant's prior consent. Prospective applicants will receive more information about this.

You’ll help define the technical direction of the platform, lead important initiatives, and build the foundation for new developer experiences. You’ll work closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and other teams to solve complex problems and turn ambitious ideas into real products.
